To determine a winner, one battle is left and it will pit Tyson going up against one of the BEGA Blader's. But who will it be? Garland offers his services, but Hiro turns him down cold saying they need Brooklyn to fight this battle. Brooklyn's on the brink of a breakdown and now it's up to Hiro to get him back into fighting form.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The final match between the G Revolutions and the BEGA Bladers has arrived. Tyson prepares for the contest, unsure of whom he will ultimately face. It isn't until he steps onto the stadium floor when he discovers that he will go face to face, against Brooklyn himself. Brooklyn shows off his incredible powers immediately, stunning both teams on either side of the Beystadium. But no one has any idea of the true extent of Brooklyn's powers until he creates a wormhole to another dimension, creating an empty shell, carbon copy of the real world! The freak out continues as Brooklyn destroys everything in his new empty world to mold it into an image that makes him happy! Tyson has never faced an opponent like this! Does he stand a chance, or will BEGA continue its evil infection of the Beyblading community?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's mid-way through Tyson and Brooklyn's final tie-breaking 'Justice 5' match which could give BEGA a stranglehold on the entire sport of Beyblading. Having suffered his only previous defeat at the hands of Kai, Brooklyn's thirst for revenge takes the form of an unearthly power. Not only has his Beyblade Zeus given Brooklyn sinister black wings with which to fly, it's generated a giant vortex in the sky that is wreaking havoc on the city. Buildings are crumbling everywhere. The entire world is being enveloped by the growing darkness. Only Tyson can stop Brooklyn before it's too late. Summoning his own formidable power from Dragoon, Tyson flies into the sky to convince Brooklyn to cease the negative emotions that are causing the havoc. When reasoning fails, the pair continues their battle above the ever-crumbling city. The tide turns in Tyson's favor when he's able to summon the spirits of his teammates' blades and merge them with Dragoon, which evolves into the most powerful Beyblade ever. By probing deeper into Brooklyn's psyche, Tyson learns that his foe's anxiety stems from childhood isolation at being a genius so early in life. Tyson makes Brooklyn see that Beyblading is a pure sport to be enjoyed for one reason alone ' the love of the game. Brooklyn calms down. The chaos ends. And the pair continues their match simply for enjoyment. With BEGA's HQ in shambles, the upstart league and its owner Boris are ruined. Mr. Dickenson's BBA league restarts, but in a much more modest form. And kids everywhere ' including Tyson and his friends - return to the simple, purest form of Beyblading.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson is at home practicing martial arts with his grandfather when suddenly he realizes he's late for a Beyblade battle with Andrew. As he runs out of his house he's confronted by a couple of bullies who only slow him up for his real battle. But when Tyson does show up, Andrew and his friends are met by a smart mouthed kid named Carlos who's a member of the notorious Blade Sharks. Carlos challenges anyone to a battle but the winner gets to keep the others Beyblades. Tyson accepts. With the help of Kenny and his Bit Beast Dizzi, who's trapped inside his laptop, Tyson prepares for the big battle, which he handily wins. But the just when the fight is over, the Blade Shark's leader Kai shows up and a new battle begins between Kai and Tyson

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson battles Kai one on one, but to his surprise, Tyson quickly loses. The Chief informs Tyson, that in order to beat Kai, you need a strategy, so Tyson goes home in an attempt to practice until he's perfected his fighting technique. Later that day, Andrew and Kenny, along with Dizzi show up and attempt to increase the power of Tyson's blade to match that of Kai, but with little success. Tyson is feeling glum about his chances of ever beating Kai, but suddenly, out of nowhere, the Bit Beast Dragoon appears and flies straight towards him and goes directly into Tyson's beyblade. Tyson is stunned after realizing Dragoon does exists and is now inside his beyblade. With renewed confidence, Tyson knows the time is right to challenge Kai once again to do battle.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: In a moment of heroism, Max, the new Beyblader in town, shows Tyson that with the proper skill and training, there is nothing that can't be achieved. The two soon become fast friends, leaving Kenny feeling left out.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Beyblade Regional Qualifying Tournament is underway as Tyson, Max, Ray and even Kenny are entered to see if they can dethrone Kai, the reigning champion. As our announcers, Brad Best and A.J. Topper rev up the crowd, Kenny is first into battle but without a Bit Beast in his blade, he falls quickly to Kai.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Max is completely overpowered in his semi-finals match against Kai. It's not until the Bit Beast known as Draciel emerges from Max's Grandmother's pendant, to add its power to Max's Beyblade that the tables begin to turn.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Qualifying Tournament is in its final stages as Tyson has advanced to face Ray in the semi-finals. As the best of three battles gets underway, Tyson's bravado quickly fades as Ray handily wins the first round when he destroys Tyson's Beyblade with his famous Tiger Claw Attack.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The National Beyblade Championship Match is set, with Tyson facing off against reigning champion, Kai. It's not until Grandpa throws a surprise party for Tyson, that the rookie sensation realizes he's forgotten his own Birthday!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson and his team prepare for the Hong Kong world championships. Kai seems to reject his newfound team and leads them on a chase through the streets. That's where the guys learn some lessons about Beyblading from some very mysterious 'bladers. After a decisive victory, Tyson and the gang discover that the alley bladders make up the membership of 'The White Tiger Team'' Whatever that is'

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Our heroes arrive in Hong Kong on a stop-over to the Asian Beyblade Tournament when they run into Ray's old gang the White Tigers. A confrontation quickly ensues with no one coming out the clear winner.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The first round of the Asian Tournament sees the Bladebreakers facing off against the team called the Tall-Boys, with Ray's ex-teammates, The White Tigers, waiting in the wings.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The night before the Asian Tournament, Kevin decides to steal data from Kenny's laptop to get the edge for his White Tiger Team. Unfortunately, Kenny catches him red-handed which sets up a battle between Ray and Kevin, which ends in dire consequences for Ray.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: After realizing his Bit Beast is gone, Ray decides to head for the mountains in an attempt to get it back. Tyson and Mariah give chase and confront Ray to decide which team he wants to be on.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The White Tiger Team faces off against the Spin-Shepards in the quarterfinals of the Asian Tournament. When Ray sees that Lee is also using the 'Tiger Claw' attack, he is forced to finally open up to his teammates about his mysterious past.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the morning of the semi-finals at the Asian Beyblade Tournament and Tyson manages to sleep in. The rest of the team leaves early, but Ray stays behind to make sure Tyson wakes up. As the tournament gets underway, Max is the first to battle. Meanwhile, Ray and Tyson are caught up in a traffic jam created by a landslide, so they decide to walk. But the shortest route is over a mountain where Ray sprains his ankle and Tyson is left to carrying him all the way to there.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The finals are about to begin in the Asian Qualifying Tournament with the winning team advancing to the World Beyblading Championships. In the first round, Max goes against Gary from the White Tigers in a best of three battle. The first round goes without a hitch as Max easily takes care of his opponent and with the win, Max becomes a little over confident.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: During the finals of the Asian Tournament, Ray faces off against his old teammate, and former friend, Mariah. When Galux and Driger team up to show the pair a glimpse of the happiness they shared in the past, Ray and Mariah come to realize how much they have lost, by being rivals.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The final match of the Asian Beyblade Tournament reaches an uncertain conclusion when Tyson and Lee's decisive battle ends in a draw. The resulting sudden death session between Ray and Lee rekindles the pair's old hometown grievances.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Fresh from the Bladebreakers win in Asia, Tyson comes home and realizes he's front page news! With his ego out of control, Tyson takes on the attitude of a rock star, which upsets Kenny who tries to keep him focused on blading and not his popularity. Meanwhile, at a local playground, the local kids are all out Beyblading when Tyson spots a kid (Nicky), being smoked in the Beystadium by a bully (Riley). After Nicky's blade is completely destroyed, Tyson vows to help the kid fix it and fight his way back.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers arrive in the USA for the American Tournament. During a tour of a BBA research facility, Max is shocked to learn that his Mom works there, and not at the college, like he thought. To make matters worse, the team discovers that they are being tested for weaknesses, by a competing team.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: After their non-competition loss to Emily of the All Starz at the BBA Research Center, the Blade Breakers sneak around the high-tech facility, hoping to learn more about their competition. There, they confront two other All Starz, and Max learns more about his Mom's job at the BBA - specifically, a rumor of why Max wasn't asked to join the All Starz Team.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: For some strange reason, Mr. Dickenson has sent the Blade Breakers to a remote mountain retreat to hone their blading skills for the upcoming American Tournament as well as to get Kenny and Dizzi to figure out a way to increase Ray's Bit Beast's power. Once there, they meet up with a enthusiastic young boy named Antonio who they think is there to train them. Turns out, Antonio is a pathetic blader.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: A charity event in the Heartland of America gives the Bladebreakers a taste of the All Starz' prowess. Featuring celebrities in a three-on-three contest against young Beybladers of note, Emily of the All Starz, bullies her way to an easy win. It isn't until Emily knocks out her own opponent, loses the second match and is on her way to throwing the whole competition, that Max teaches her what teamwork is all about.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers arrive in Las Vegas for the start of the American Tournament. Tyson looks forward to facing off against the arrogant All-Starz, and their scientifically advanced Beyblades'but first his team needs to get past the 'Renegades' in the qualifying round. Kai surprises everyone by stepping into the dish for the first battle!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Blade Breakers have advanced to the second round of the American Tournament where they square off against the Savage Slammers. The winner of this round advances to the semi-finals. Their competition first appears to be a bunch of slackers, but when Ray loses out in the first round, they quickly realize what they're up against. Max is next, and for some odd reason, his rival folds under pressure, so the best of three is tied at one a piece with Tyson coming in for the deciding battle.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the Bladebreakers versus Spintensity in the semi-finals of the American Tournament. But before the match can begin, Tyson is forced to withdraw with a stomachache he got from too much celebratory eating. Max, Ray and Kai must drag race their crafty foes through the whirlwind, highway-themed dish called the New Jersey Turnpike.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tensions rise as the American Tournament heats up. Max fights for a chance to beyblade against his mother's team the All-Starz in an upcoming match, while Tyson and the rest of the Bladebreakers realize that the All-Starz are a bigger threat then they previously thought. At the end of two tense rounds, Tyson and Steven are tied one-all'

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the finals of the American Tournament and the Bladebreakers are going head to head with the All Starz with the winner going to the World Championships. In the first round, Tyson is pitted against Steve and at first things don't appear to be going Tyson's way. But with sheer determination, Tyson pulls out a victory that puts the Bladebreakers ahead one to nothing in the best of three finals.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The deciding match of the American Tournament Finals comes down to Max vs. Michael of the 'All Starz,' in a battle that pits science and technology against human spirit. Unfortunately for Max and the Bladebreakers, the trick dish turns out to be a replica of a baseball diamond'where Michael feels right at home!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: After narrowly defeating the All Starz at the American Tournament, Kenny decides he should record a database of the highs and low points of the BladeBreakers since the very beginning. In fact, through a series of flashbacks, the Chief along with Dizzi, takes a trip down memory lane as far back to the first time he ever met Tyson. With clips from various shows, Kenny narrates the progress of his friends who eventually form the BladeBreakers and go on to the Asian Tournament.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Traveling by boat across the Atlantic, the Bladebreakers must not only deal with Kenny's seasickness, but a gut-wrenching revelation. Tyson's on-board defeat at the hands of a mysterious foe - one wielding a Bit-Beast larger and stronger than any they've ever seen - exposes the team's vulnerability going into the Russian Tournament.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The kids are tricked into missing their boat, forcing them to spend the night in London where a mysterious videotape of Tyson's father is delivered to them. Later, Tyson's Beyblade is stolen and the kids are lured into a fight with the evil Cenotaph and his powerful Bit Beast, Sarcopholon. All seems lost until Kai defeats the mummy by using his own strengths against him. The team agrees to travel by land, learning from every European Beyblader they can find.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: After their train is mysteriously hijacked, the kids find themselves in the dark recesses of a tunnel. This is where the Bladebreakers meet the members of the Dark Bladers! Soon the team is forced into a beyblade match to rescue Kenny from the monsters' evil clutches! But Kenny isn't the only prize in this dark match-up. For if the Bladebreakers lose, their bit-beasts are up for grabs'

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: As the BladeBreakers make their way to the World Championships in Russia, they are stuck in Paris where they end up wasting a day looking for Kai who had mysteriously disappeared. Tyson comes up with the idea of using the Eiffel Tower as a vantage point to speed up their search. Ray, Kenny, Tyson and Max make their way to the observation deck of the tower where they are confronted by the Dark Bladers, a foursome of zombie-like ghouls who have vowed to steal the Bladebreakers Bit Beasts as part of their ultimate plan to capture all Bit Beasts in the world. A massive battle ensues but the odds are against our heroes. Finally, Kai shows up with his newly modified Dranzer and almost single-handedly wins the battle. The Dark Bladers fade away after their humiliating loss and just when you'd think it's over, a mysterious kid named Oliver shows up'

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers spend an extra day in Paris and split up to see the sights. Ray catches up with his uncle, Max goes on a wild shopping spree and Kai goes in search of information. Tyson and Kenny try to see the Louvre but end up Beyblading Oliver, the French Champion. At first Oliver's Bit Beast, Unicolyon, is too much for Dragoon. But Tyson soon proves that even the French Champion has a thing or two to learn about Beyblading.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers arrive in Rome, searching for the mysterious Enrique. Scoffing at their Beyblade challenge, Enrique decides he'd rather spend the day with some of his lady-friends. But Tyson soon convinces him to 'Let it rip!' And after seeing Enrique's personalized BeyStadium, and his outrageous bit-beast, there's a good chance that Tyson may regret his actions'

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Unwilling to let his initial defeat to Enrique faze him, Tyson gets busy reworking his Beyblade. With Enrique having doubts about his own technique, and Oliver visiting him in Rome from France, the stage is set for a rematch. This time, Tyson pits the two heads of Enrique's Bit Beast Amphilyon against each other, and saves Enrique's life when Amphilyon turns on him.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Enrique and Oliver decide to take our heroes on a dirigible ride to visit Robert's castle. The reason - Tyson hopes to avenge an earlier loss to Robert that happened onboard the ship coming to Europe. Tyson's patience, however, is tested when they have to sit and wait for their host who is 'not to be disturbed.' So, Tyson decides to find Robert on his own and ends up getting lost in the medieval castles many eerie secret passages. Finally everyone converges in the room where Robert is playing chess against Johnny and it's here where Tyson throws down the gauntlet and challenges Robert to a rematch. Robert refuses and goes into a whole history lesson about how 'once you've defeated your enemy, the battle is over.' Meanwhile, the arrogant little Johnny decides to pick a battle with the most-worthy opponent in the room and chooses Kai. As the fight begins, it appears to be even, but then Johnny calls out his Bit Beast Salamulyon and totally destroys him. In the end, the Bladebreakers resolve that they have their work cut out for them to become the world champion Beybladers!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers have made themselves at home at Robert's mansion, refusing to leave unless the Europeans agree to a final Beybattle. To teach his guests a lesson, Robert agrees to a match at his new stadium. But there's one condition: If the Bladebreakers lose, they have to forfeit their berth at the world Championship. Ray and Oliver battle fiercely and the first round ends in a tie. Johnny and Kai, bitter rivals, step to the bowl. But can Kai defeat the man who defeated him?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Match two gets underway at the Olympia Coliseum, and with a little unsolicited help by his teammates, Kai walks away with a win. The match is tied and the Majestics grudgingly admit to themselves that the only way they'll win the contest is to fight as a team, as the Bladebreakers do. Facing off against Tyson in the final match, will Robert be able to apply the fundamentals of teamwork? And will the Bladebreakers ever discover who sent them on their cross-Europe trip in the first place'?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers arrive in Moscow on a brisk winter's day in anticipation of the World Beyblading final tournament. As they search for their hotel in the chilly city, they happen upon Boris, a strange man who claims to be the head of a rather eerie Beyblading training center. With the charm of an old world count, Boris invites them to lunch and them brings them to the training facility where they meet the next generation of Beybladers. It's here where Boris decides that one of his pupils should test his blading skills against Tyson.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers run into some old friends in Russia when The All-Starz and the White Tiger Clan show up for an exhibition match. The Beybattle between the two teams ends in a tie and they become fast friends, except for Emily and Mariah, who refuse to speak to each other. Meanwhile, Kai returns to the Abbey to find out why it fills him with foreboding. He discovers a cruel Beyblade facility in the Sub-basements, housing twisted science experiments and an army of children being molded into deadly Beybladers. Kai's lost memories come flooding back as he realizes he was raised in the abbey. But has he discovered the truth too late?

programme.title: Terror in Resonance [English Dub]
programme.desc: Tokyo is suddenly hit by a massive bombing. Two young men who call themselves “Sphinx” start an epic game involving the whole of Japan.

programme.title: Terror in Resonance [English Dub]
programme.desc: Tokyo is suddenly hit by a massive bombing. Two young men who call themselves “Sphinx” start an epic game involving the whole of Japan.

programme.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood [English Dub]
programme.desc: The Elrics meet Shou Tucker, a leading researcher in the field of chimeras. He has much to teach Ed and Al about alchemy - and the horrible cruelty that sometimes accompanies it.

programme.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood [English Dub]
programme.desc: Edward and Alphonse are attacked by Scar, a mysterious killer wanted for a string of gruesome murders. His powers are incredible - and his obsession with slaying State Alchemists might be justified.

programme.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood [English Dub]
programme.desc: Before arriving at the Rockbell home for repairs, the Elrics meet Dr. Marcoh, a State Alchemist running from past sins. The information he gives Ed and Al could put the Philosopher's Stone within reach.

programme.title: Naruto the Movie 2 : Legend of the Stone of Gelel [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Drawn into a fierce struggle over the legendary Stone of Gelel, Naruto, Shikamaru, and Sakura must keep the stone from falling into the wrong hands.

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: Dr. Eggman reveals to Sonic that he had been double-crossed by Chaos. As Knuckles warns Sonic of dangers of Chaos if he was to obtain the last Chaos Emerald, they are transported to the past by a mysterious red orb.

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: As he hacks GUN's computer database, Dr. Eggman discovers his grandfather's mysterious "Ultimate Life Form" project named Shadow.

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: Sonic is accused of causing havoc in Prison Island. As GUN agents seek after Sonic, Sonic attempts to figure out who had framed him.

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Dub]
programme.desc: A Count challenges Lupin to steal a gemstone named Dracula's Tear from on board his airship, the Hendenburg. However, also on board the Hendenburg are several formidable detectives: Sherlock Holmes III, Philip Archer, Kosuke Kindani and Inspector Zenigata. Will Lupin accept the Count's challenge and will he be able to complete the task before the airship lands, where the police will be waiting for him?

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Dub]
programme.desc: Lupin is suffering from Transformation Sickness, an illness that transforms him into a cruel, cold-blooded criminal at the stroke of midnight, and leaves him with no recollection of his murderous crime spree in the morning. In despair, Lupin even contemplates taking his own life, but is the "other Lupin" really Lupin?

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: Oga hears about the legendary Tojo, the final and strongest member of Ishiyama's TKKH, from Furuichi. And right away, he goes for a showdown! Well, if he knew where Tojo was. Thanks to Himekawa's digging, Oga, Hilda, and the rest head to the beach where Tojo is supposed to be working part-time...

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: Their work done, Doctor Furcas and Lamia head back to the Demon World, but Oga, Beel, and Furuichi accidentally hitch along for the ride! With Alaindelon out of commission after exceeding his maximum interdimensional transfer weight limit, the gang has no choice but to search for his daughter, but they have to make it through Vlad's Haunt in one piece first!

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: In search of Alaindelon's daughter so they can get back home, Oga and the gang head to a city of criminal Demon Beast poachers to rescue her. But before they get the chance, a giant monster appears to take revenge on the poachers for the harm they've done to Vlad's Haunt. And the only one who can stand toe-to-toe with it is... Baby Beel?!

programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Ando is struggling with the fact that his friend Shishigami is responsible for the spree of home invasions. After reading that hospital patients were being cured, Ando theorizes that there is someone else out there with the same powers as Shishigami. programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Dub]

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: Their work done, Doctor Furcas and Lamia head back to the Demon World, but Oga, Beel, and Furuichi accidentally hitch along for the ride! With Alaindelon out of commission after exceeding his maximum interdimensional transfer weight limit, the gang has no choice but to search for his daughter, but they have to make it through Vlad's Haunt in one piece first!

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: In search of Alaindelon's daughter so they can get back home, Oga and the gang head to a city of criminal Demon Beast poachers to rescue her. But before they get the chance, a giant monster appears to take revenge on the poachers for the harm they've done to Vlad's Haunt. And the only one who can stand toe-to-toe with it is... Baby Beel?!

programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: As Shion believed he was innocent, Shishigami confesses to her that his body is a robot and has taken many lives in order to feel alive again. He coldly informs her that he will kill everyone in the country. However, Shion begs Shishigami not to leave her behind. Shion cries as she tells Shishigami that the people he's killed had futures and loved ones, and Shishigami makes a proposition.

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: A special forces team bursts in to apprehend Shishigami. Shion and her grandmother are shot in the crossfire, and Shishigami manages to grab them before escaping. After taking them to safety, he wishes Shion a happy life. One day, Mari sees her father and Ando together. She follows after and sees Inuyashiki fly off into the sky. That night, Shishigami attacks a police station in vengeance.

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: As the news reports on Shishigami's attack on the police station, Shishigami hijacks a broadcast signal to publicly declare war on Japan, claiming he will kill 100 people immediately. Ando realizes Shishigami's plans and manages to thwart it with the help of Inuyashiki's power. Undeterred, Shishigami continues his killing, and announces he will kill 1000 tomorrow, devastating Inuyashiki.

programme.desc: Una horda de zombis invade la granja y el grupo intenta escapar vivo entre el caos, pero no todos lo lograrán. Además, Rick se harta de las quejas del grupo y les da un ultimátum: si quieren que sea el líder, acatarán sus órdenes.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: El grupo encuentra refugio en las instalaciones de una prisión federal abandonada tras meses en la carretera. Rick considera que se trata de un lugar seguro para que Lori pase los últimos meses de embarazo, pero quizá se haya equivocado.

programme.title: The Walking Dead

programme.desc: Michonne ve a Glenn y Maggie buscando provisiones, pero alguien más los observa: Merle, quien reconoce a Glenn como uno de los que le abandonó, a merced de los zombis, en una azotea de Atlanta. Entretanto, Rick sigue mentalmente inestable.

programme.title: Homestate

Plus, see how the Kardashian’s doctor boosts the booty without a scalpel in just 30 minutes! Go inside the OR to see the surgeries to give you sexy bedroom eyes, a perfect pout, and the ideal hourglass figure!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: All summer long, teams of plastic surgeons, cosmetic dentists and dozens of stylists worked around the clock. Now, The Doctors presents a makeover show so big, a call had to be made to The Guinness Book of World Records!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: The Doctors answer the questions you’re too embarrassed to talk about – even with your best friend! Find out how to improve your love life, eliminate body odor and more!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Fix your biggest pains with food! Learn how what you eat can help heal heartburn, soothe toothaches, ease PMS symptoms and more. Plus, snacks that can make migraines and earaches worse. And, how a dill pickle could ease arthritis.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Whether it’s puberty, menopause or old age, learn how to stay healthy at every age. Plus, get the ultimate guide to treating adolescent acne, and learn how to help your baby take his or first steps!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Sore throat, upset stomach, aches and pains -- find out when you’re most contagious and when it’s safe to go back to school or the office. And, how to determine if your child is too sick for school.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Send the kids out of the room, turn down the lights and get ready, because it's a special Ask Our Doctors day! From orgasm trouble to manscaping to Passion Parties, nothing is off limits as The Doctors discuss all things.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Can a high-tech surveillance company keep your kids safe at school? Attorney and psychologist Lisa Strohman weighs in on the hot-button issue. OB/GYN facing charges of health care fraud after allegedly performing unnecessary surgeries on patients! Is the paleo diet safe while breastfeeding? A controversial new bill in Colorado is proposing young adults be tried as juveniles because the brain isn’t fully developed. Neuroscientist Dr. Don Vaughn and attorney and psychologist Dr. Lisa Strohman debate the pros and cons.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Insta-famous fitness star Abby Pollock is known for her “peach booty” that’s so perfect some say it’s fake! A live glute ultrasound reveals the truth, while Abby shares a shocking admission about her past. When a bad habit becomes debilitating, a woman turns to The Doctors for help! Special correspondent Rosie Mercado joins The Doctors and is shocked to hear that people are putting apple cider vinegar… down where? Is there any truth to the internet rumor urging women to try DIY “tightening”? Could a contraceptive gel for men change birth control forever? Should you stay friends with your ex? Hear what The Doctors has to say! Then, Dr. Travis tears up as he talks about his beloved dog, Nala, and her health struggles. A 97-year-old record-breaking sprinter … how does he do it? And, the easiest way to peel garlic, ever!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: The Doctors reveals surprising symptoms that may indicate your life is at risk. From stroke, diabetes and thyroid function, to liver, kidney and heart failure; find out how to stop a medical catastrophe before it happens.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Get the facts about women's heart disease with singer and philanthropist Barbra Streisand, founder of the eponymous cardiovascular research program. And, cardiologist Dr. Noel Bairey shares vital tests every woman must take.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: The Doctors tackle topics from the bedroom to the bathroom that make even the most stalwart blush. Hear S-E-X-planations for how to turn up the heat in the bedroom, and get solutions for ugly feet, spider veins and more!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: A new “natural” filler is revealed LIVE on the show! A woman discovers her home has become a beehive and turns to THE DOCTORS for help! Would you choose to stay pregnant for 5 years to avoid maternity leave? THE DOCTORS tackles paid maternity leave. In a THE DOCTORS exclusive, a mom raises awareness about the rare disease turning her daughter into a “hulk baby” … and THE DOCTORS surprises her in ways she never saw coming! Climate control bedding is put to the test! And, are your kids at risk for kitchen burns? Are you making cleaning mistakes that could make you sick? Get the facts!

programme.title: Great Destinations Africa
programme.desc: Great Destinations of the World takes you to some of the most beautiful and exotic places on the planet. With unbelievable views and fascinating commentary, you will discover these exquisite destinations hold more history than you ever imagined. Travel to picturesque locations in America, Africa, Asia, and Europe. Learn the history of each place, delight in the local cuisine, listen to native music, and leave with feeling like you just experienced some of the most exciting places on the planet.

programme.title: Sarah Graham’s Food Safari
programme.desc: Food blogger and cookbook author, Sarah Graham, takes her kitchen on the road through Africa.

programme.title: Hidden Italy
programme.desc: The duchy of Castro was founded in 1537 by Pope Paul III, Alessandro Farnese, who wanted to donate the area to his son Pier Luigi. The dukedom includes not only Ischia di Castro, the capital city that was destroyed in 1649 by the Papal troops, but also Valentano and Capodimonte where you can still admire the amazing palaces of the Farnese family...

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: With the Chief’s blessing—and a gesture of goodwill in the form of Canadian maple syrup—Jeff is invited to spend a day immersed in the region’s haunting past. Guided by the Chief, he visits rubber trees still standing as silent witnesses to the atrocities of the 1920s Amazon rubber boom, where the Chief’s own grandparents were slaughtered. The journey leads to the ruins of the Arana Brothers’ former headquarters, a chilling site of colonial exploitation, brutality, and genocide. In this moving episode, history, memory, and reconciliation converge deep in the jungle.

programme.title: American Travelers
programme.desc: Dave & Kari visit the Dominican Republic and explore the town of Samana, then go to Bacardi Island.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Brent starts his day with some adrenaline pumping sea karting on the West Coast of the Island. He then heads to the home of Manuella to have an Otentik Creole experience with her and her family. A mix of African and European cuisines influenced by Asia, Creole cuisine is a delicious, colorful melting pot of flavours and Manuella teaches Brent just how to blend these notes to create a unique dish. Tasty creole food and too much rum later Brent is having a ball. The next morning Brent hits the markets to get his ingredients for his creole inspired dish. Heading back to the Ravenala hotel he has a refresher before cooking up his own creole creation on the Riviera Riverside.

programme.title: Road Trip Masters
programme.desc: (Part 1 of 2) The boys roll drop top into the Pocono Mountains where they take on this massive area that is the size of the State of Delaware. Racing, resorts, and golf occupy their time in PA!

The dukedom includes not only Ischia di Castro, the capital city that was destroyed in 1649 by the Papal troops, but also Valentano and Capodimonte where you can still admire the amazing palaces of the Farnese family...

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: With the Chief’s blessing—and a gesture of goodwill in the form of Canadian maple syrup—Jeff is invited to spend a day immersed in the region’s haunting past. Guided by the Chief, he visits rubber trees still standing as silent witnesses to the atrocities of the 1920s Amazon rubber boom, where the Chief’s own grandparents were slaughtered. The journey leads to the ruins of the Arana Brothers’ former headquarters, a chilling site of colonial exploitation, brutality, and genocide. In this moving episode, history, memory, and reconciliation converge deep in the jungle.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Brent starts his day with some adrenaline pumping sea karting on the West Coast of the Island. He then heads to the home of Manuella to have an Otentik Creole experience with her and her family. A mix of African and European cuisines influenced by Asia, Creole cuisine is a delicious, colorful melting pot of flavours and Manuella teaches Brent just how to blend these notes to create a unique dish. Tasty creole food and too much rum later Brent is having a ball. The next morning Brent hits the markets to get his ingredients for his creole inspired dish. Heading back to the Ravenala hotel he has a refresher before cooking up his own creole creation on the Riviera Riverside.

programme.title: Hidden Italy
programme.desc: In 1545, Pope Paul III took Parma and Piacenza away from the papal territories to create a new duchy for his son Pier Luigi Farnese and free them from the influence of the Lombard Gonzaga family. The first duke and his heirs Alessandro and Ranuccio welcomed some Correggio's to work in the baptistery of the cathedral and some Parmigianino's paintings in the monastery of San Paolo.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: As the floating hospital leaves La Chorrera, Jeff arrives in the village of Providencia—home to the Bora people, whose culture is deeply tied to the sacred triad of coca, tobacco, and cassava. Unexpectedly, Jeff stumbles upon a rare and powerful event: a regional summit where Indigenous chiefs from across the Amazon have gathered to discuss peace, territory, and cultural preservation—an event many call the “G7 of the Amazon.” Following tradition, Jeff must await an invitation to meet the local chief. While respectfully waiting, he spends a day with a local fisherman, navigating the winding rivers and gaining insight into traditional fishing practices passed down through generations.

programme.title: American Travelers
programme.desc: Dave & Kari visit Lake Tahoe, California and check out the Sierra Boat Company.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Mauritius is a multi-ethnic, multilingual and multicultural society. After chatting to his guide, Denis, about his Indian heritage Brent is curious to get to know more about the unique Hindu culture of Mauritius. Travelling deep into the heart of the island he heads to Ganga Talao, a sacred crater lake situated in a secluded mountain area where a temple dedicated to Lord Shiva brings in hundreds of pilgrims every day. There he meets with Priest Dayal who takes him on a tour of Hindu culture and beliefs, opening Brent's eyes to a fascinating part of this multifaceted island. Being ever the adrenalin junky, Brent isn't willing to let the rain put a dampener on his planned quad biking safari. Speeding through the pouring rain, Brent heads to the top of a mountain in the Domaine De L'Etoile Réserve, in hopes of catching a glimpse of the fabled view. He then returns to his apartment and is warmed up by some tasty fusion Indian cooking using the Mauritian staple, Okra.

programme.title: V Is For Vino
programme.desc: Virginia is the birthplace of wine in America! We talk with the innovators and pioneers who have helped establish this wine region as one of the most exciting in the county. We also visit a goat cheese farm, one of JFKs favorite hangout towns, Middleburg, and discuss Thomas Jefferson's effect on the region. From juicy Cabernet Franc to floral Viognier, funky Petit Manseng, and powerful Petit Verdot, Virginia has a wine for everyone.

programme.title: V Is For Vino
programme.desc: Southern Rhone may be the most beautiful wine region in France! Stunning landscapes, quaint villages, ancient geography, and tons of Côtes du Rhône vineyards, all winding along the Rhône River in the South of France. The winemakers have tremendous respect for the land and work hard to preserve its legacy. Join Vince and his friend and local Frenchman, Sarkis, on a road trip through this wonderful wine region while learning about the fresh & fun red, rosé, and white wines of Southern Rhône!

programme.title: V Is For Vino
programme.desc: Chile is the perfect gateway to explore the rich diversity and value of South American wines! From vibrant Cabernet Sauvignon to velvety Carménère, the wines produced in Chile mirror its extraordinary geography—cool Pacific breezes and the towering Andes mountains. Add to that the warmth of welcoming locals, breathtaking landscapes, and delectable cuisine, and you've crafted the perfect recipe for an unforgettable wine adventure.

programme.title: V Is For Vino
programme.desc: Languedoc-Roussillon is France's largest wine region and has more organic vineyard land than anywhere else on the planet! Its sheer size means it can produce an enormous variety of wine styles, from sparkling wines to rich whites, spicy reds, and even luscious dessert wines. Biodynamic winemaking pioneer Gérard Bertrand takes center stage, highlighting why caring for the planet and producing incredible wines aren't mutually exclusive.

programme.title: V Is For Vino
programme.desc: Lebanon is remarkable! It's one of the world’s oldest wine regions, full of resilient people, ancient winegrowing heritage, and fresh cuisine that rivals any gastronomy on the planet! Besides having a robust winegrowing history, the country’s Mediterranean climate and mountainous terrain produce a host of delicious, fresh wines, from crisp indigenous white grapes like Obeidy and Merwah to rich, spicy blends of Cabernet and Syrah. Plus, the food is some of the most flavorful in the world, and the people have a zest for life.

Marcelo recibe un ascenso pero enfrenta crisis familiar tras ser descubierto con su amante. Benjamín planea apoderarse de la fortuna Tariffi, lo que lleva a Margot a pedir protección para su hija. Mientras tanto, Celia ruega a sus hijos permanecer unidos, y María del Pilar duda entre Marcelo y Gustavo.

Isaías, borracho, es asaltado por malandros confabulados con el taxista y queda tirado en la calle. Natalia revela a Eustoquio que Erasto no es su padrino sino su padre, dejándolo en shock. Carmen encuentra a Rosa furiosa y la manda a dormir. Eustoquio interroga a Arminda quien queda muda. Erasto se obsesiona con destruir a Adolfo para quedarse con Consuelo. Leonardo no puede entender cómo es que Irene tuvo un hijo con Felipe y la razón por la cuál ella no lo deja acercarse a Mateo. programme.title: Toda Mujer

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Alejandro pide a José Luis que lleve a Rosa para enfrentarla y reclamarle haberlo engañado. Adolfo descubre por Amalia toda la mentira de Rosalía. Carmen encuentra a Rosa furiosa y la manda a dormir. Eustoquio interroga a Arminda quien queda muda. Erasto se obsesiona con destruir a Adolfo para quedarse con Consuelo. programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Rebeca aparece cuando lo están llevando preso a Leo y culpa a María Lucía de que él este en problemas, a lo que Trinidad decide irse enojada de la casa junto con Anzola. Cuando estaban saliendo se encontraron con Oriana, quién muy enojada, le dice a Trinidad que Leo le juró que iba a cambiar y que iba a estar con ella, pero Trinidad le dice que este le envió una carta de amor muy importante a su nieta. Leonardo no puede entender cómo es que Irene tuvo un hijo con Felipe y la razón por la cuál ella no lo deja acercarse a Mateo. programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Alejandro confirma que no es hermano de Sol y le pide al Médico que le dé un papel donde conste esto. programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Agustina escucha a Julio contarle a Fernando que él fue quien metió preso a Leo. Su tía lo confronta violentamente y ante la amenaza de exponerlo frente a su padre, Julio le miente diciendo que lo dijo para impresionar a Fernando. Tony visita a Leo en la cárcel. Leo se queja amargamente de la falta de atención de su familia. María Lucía recibe el reto de su abuela por la carta de Leo hallada en la caja de música. Luego, junto a Sandra, reconstruyen la carta, la cual muestra el amor de Leo por ella. Leonardo, Irene y Maribel están en un hotel fuera de la ciudad para arreglar la situación de las fórmulas de Galeano. Entre los ex cónyuges, la tensión es creciente.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Con la prueba de ADN en sus manos, de que no es hermano de Sol, Alejandro habla con está y le dice que le tiene una gran sorpresa. Pero luego es secuestrado por un par de maleantes que responden a Heriberto. Heriberto chantajea a Anselmo y logra salir de la cárcel, ve a Alejandro y le dice que hoy Sol será su mujer. Reina escapa de su custodia policial en el hospital. Giselle y Cristo José están de acuerdo en decirle la verdad Giselita de que tiene dos madres.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Olegario le reclama a Pastor lo el pan de jamón. Pastor piensa que le interesa Ana y en ese momento se presenta Clarisa. Freddy la aconseja para que se quede. Atanasio le cuenta a Armando lo de Graciela Armando piensa y se lo dice a Atanasio que es como la película Atracción Fatal.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.desc: Cristina monta en cólera al enterarse que Gerson está sembrando guayabas porque ella sabe que lo hace para ayudarle en el negocio a Yureima. Por otro lado, Pascua está feliz de que fue aprobado el crédito para su negocio.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Katiuska publica una foto comprometedora para separar a Ricardo y Manuela, desatando conflictos familiares y laborales. Graciela cae en depresión y Marcelo teme perder a sus hijos. Finalmente, Misael le muestra el periódico a Manuela, quien queda profundamente dolida al ver la imagen de Ricardo y Katiuska.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Leo está detenido por la denuncia que Alejandra hizo porque él entró en su departamento. Felipe está llevando adelante el caso y le advirtió a Altamirano que será destituida de su cargo. Jimena se entera que Carlos Ernesto tiene un documento en Tribunales que puede reabrir el caso de Miguel, lo cual la enfurece e intenta evitarlo, pero Carlos Ernesto está convencido en continuar con el caso para limpiar el nombre de Virginia y encontrar al verdadero asesino. María Lucía y Oriana siguen confundidas por Leo, piensan que está jugando con las dos. Galeano piensa que Mateo es hijo de Leonardo y que él e Irene están juntos. Esto siembra la duda en Leonardo, quien más tarde indaga a Irene para que le responda si Mateo es o no hijo suyo.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Heriberto mantiene encerrado a Alejandro para evitar que se interponga en sus planes de hacer el amor con Sol. El secuaz de Heriberto sorprende a Reina merodeando por el refugio. Entonces, Heriberto y ella acuerdan ayudarse mutuamente, pero cada uno tiene agendas diferentes. Sol comienza a desesperarse por la desaparición de Alejandro. Llama al jefe Tavares y éste le sugiere que esperen hasta el día siguiente. El jefe sabe la verdad pero quiere que Alejandro se lo diga

programme.title: Silencio en la nieve
programme.desc: En plena Segunda Guerra Mundial, un asesino en serie aparece dentro de la División Azul, cuerpo de soldados españoles voluntarios que combatieron en el frente ruso junto a las tropas alemanas. Tras el hallazgo del cadáver de un soldado español que ha sido degollado y presenta en el hombro una inscripción grabada a cuchillo ("Mira que te mira Dios"), se abre una investigación de la que se encarga el soldado Arturo Andrade, que asume la tarea con rigor y profesionalidad. Arturo cuenta con la ayuda del Sargento Espinosa, y pronto ambos empiezan a sospechar que detrás del asesinato se ocultan oscuros secretos del pasado.

programme.title: Kill Kane
programme.desc: Un hombre busca venganza cuando su esposa e hijos son asesinados a manos de una pandilla despiadada. Dado por muerto y sin nadie a quien recurrir, sale a la calle en busca de justicia y toma el asunto en sus propias manos.

programme.title: Top 10: Secretos y misterios
programme.desc: Hoy analizaremos habilidades sobrenaturales como la resistencia a caminar por el fuego o la penitencia.

programme.title: Guyana
programme.desc: En el suroeste de Guyana se extienden vastas praderas, las sabanas de Rupununi y sus colinas. Son únicas en el mundo y están llenas de misterio, su fauna y flora guardan muchas sorpresas. Pero es un mundo de extremos entre el agua y el polvo, donde la anaconda se siente como en casa y donde el hombre y el animal deben reafirmarse.

programme.title: Hecho en Chinatown
programme.desc: Es Goodfellas y Ip Man cuando un joven chino don nadie se propone convertirse en Don de la mafia italiana. programme.desc: El Chema se la juega en Colombia para conseguir una gran cantidad de droga. Navarro tiene ubicado al capo y coordina un operativo para su captura. Amado tiene un mal presentimiento.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: La gobernadora Ahumada acusa públicamente a Pío José de ser El Cabo y él va por ella a eliminarla. Pero los enemigos del colombiano llegan al mismo tiempo y se arma una balacera.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Diana le avisa a su hermana que pronto va a estar con su mamá. Castillo logra interceptar la llamada y monta un operativo para capturar a los Casillas y rescatar a la gobernadora.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Los Casillas hacen alianza con la DEA para entregar a la gobernadora. Pío aprovecha el momento, haciendo que Jaime se la entregue en bandeja de plata. Navarro pacta con Ámbar y Edith.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: La gobernadora piensa que ya está lejos del peligro de los colombianos. Pero Jaime le avisa a Pío que van rumbo a Coahuila para que él pueda ejecutar su venganza. Chema recibe malas noticias.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El que se mete con El Cabo tiene los días contados. La gobernadora no le teme al narco colombiano, por el contrario, le da un golpe duro donde más le duele. Los Casillas buscan a Esther.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Diana pierde el control al enterarse de que ejecutaron a su madre. Amado le pide que mantenga la cabeza fría para afrontar la situación, pero ella lo único que quiere es hacer justicia.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Uzcátegui queda impresionada al ver el video que le mandó El Cabo para mostrarlo en su noticiero, pero la reportera se arriesga y le envía un mensaje al colombiano. El Chema le falla a Volpi.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Ámbar está dispuesta a entregar al Chema y comparte su plan con Navarro. El agente no tiene otra opción que confiar en ella y monta un operativo para la captura. Corina le informa a Amado.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Chema y sus hombres se dan cuenta de que el gobierno los tiene sitiados; deciden escapar por las coladeras. Pero Navarro y Castillo no permitirán que huyan. Nace la hija de Ismael y Laura.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Las autoridades se juegan la última carta para capturar al Chema Venegas, quien siempre logra escapar. Pero Corina no se rinde y continúa su cacería. Diana tiene a Volpi en la mira.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Castillo y Navarro aceleran la extradición del Chema. Las cosas se complican para los agentes cuando una persona con más poder evita el traslado del capo. Diana utiliza sus encantos con Volpi.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Diana es acorralada por la familia y se ve obligada a contarles que estuvo con Renzo Volpi. Amado enfurece y le deja claro cómo serán las cosas. Amarantha le declara la guerra a Navarro.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Los Casillas confirman que la casa de Volpi es un laboratorio de fentanilo y planean destruirlo con la misma estrategia que usaba la leyenda de "El señor de los cielos". Diana logra su objetivo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Navarro ordena que monitoreen la casa de Edith para saber si Ámbar se oculta allí. Identifica a Istúriz, su mano derecha, e inmediatamente da la orden de allanar la residencia.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Los Casillas tienen al abogado de Pío y quieren información sobre el colombiano. Amado le da una lección a Diana para demostrarle que él sabe lo que hace. El Cabo jura eliminar a Ismael.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Diana llama a Volpi para encontrarse con él y no se percata de que Athina la escucha. La griega ve una chance para vengar a su familia y junto al Rojo la siguen. Colón interroga a Dalila.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Los Casillas atacan el restaurante donde se encuentra Diana con Renzo Volpi. Se arma una balacera sangrienta entre ambos carteles, que deja varios muertos. Colón descubre el secreto de Dalila.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Después de la caída del líder de Los Balcanes, Pío Valdivia no se aguanta las ganas de tomar posesión del negocio. Pero Ojeda no se la pone tan fácil. Los Casillas sufren por uno de ellos.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Después de que lograron sacar a Volpi del camino, los Casillas maquinan su próximo paso para atacar al Cabo y a Ojeda. El destino está a punto de sorprenderlos. Ámbar se disfraza de Edith.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Dylan hace todo lo posible para evitar que los Casillas se crucen con su socio colombiano, Pío Valdivia, y se arme una matanza en el bar. Ocurre una situación que pone a todos en alerta.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Chema sabe que las cosas no se ven bien para él y teme que lo extraditen a Estados Unidos. No tiene otra opción que poner su destino en manos de los Casillas. Navarro se sale con la suya.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: En una rueda de prensa, Navarro le informa a la nación sobre la extradición del Chema Venegas a Estados Unidos. Tras la noticia, los Casillas toman una decisión final sobre el rescate del capo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Diana y Vitamina son sorprendidos y acorralados en el aeropuerto de Toluca. Ella y su escolta se enfrentan a Alfaro y a sus hombres con puras balas. Ámbar le hace una mala jugada a Valdés.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Los Casillas atacan el convoy, pero Castillo da la orden de seguir, ya que la camioneta está protegida. Amado detiene a Alfaro y le exige que suelte a Diana o se atenga a las consecuencias.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Joaquín se les escapa a los hombres del Cabo y prepara una emboscada para él y Evelina. El colombiano se entera y da la orden que lo traigan como sea. Ámbar negocia con los Casillas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Evelina llega al centro comercial para verse con Joaquín. Ahí, se enfrentan los Casillas con el cartel del Cabo y ella intenta salvar su vida en medio de una lluvia de balas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Pío Valdivia queda destrozado por la muerte de su mujer y sabe que el abogado es el culpable. Joaquín teme que lo maten y hace planes para huir del país lo antes posible.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Los Casillas saben que deben primero eliminar a Valdés para llegar directo al Cabo. Con ayuda de Maldonado arman un plan para engatusarlo y que caiga en la trampa. Valdés llega a casa de Edith.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Amado le propone a Navarro que hagan una alianza entre ellos, pero no llegan a un acuerdo. El agente lo amenaza con un arma y le aclara que él es la autoridad. Pío le hace una exigencia a Dylan.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Ojeda da rienda suelta a su locura y Alejandra paga las consecuencias. Dalila tiene miedo y quiere dejarla tirada en otro lugar para no verse involucrados. Cecilio le hace escoger a Dylan.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Súper Javi y Ángela van al hospital. El doctor les informa que Alejandra fue golpeada y violada. Investigan sus pasos para ver quién la agredió. Laura apoya a Ismael en su decisión.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Los Casillas quieren atacar a Ojeda por diferentes lados. Amado ordena seguir a Dalila para llegar a él. Ella se da cuenta e intenta escapar, pero se ve acorralada por Skinny.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Los Casillas quieren que corra la noticia de que Ismael reclamó el liderazgo del cartel. A través de Dalila, mandan un mensaje tentador a Ojeda, el cual él no podrá rechazar.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Para asegurarse de que Dalila no los traicione, Corina y Colón le hacen una propuesta a Amado que lo pone muy incómodo, aún más cuando él le cuenta a Diana del plan. Dylan cita al Greñas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Diana no puede controlar sus celos y discute con Amado. Él quiere saber si su relación es lo suficientemente fuerte para resistir lo que se viene con respecto a Dalila. Fidencio sorprende a Rita.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Deportes
programme.desc: Platicamos con Adriana “Ady” Jiménez, clavadista mexicana y campeona mundial de clavados de altura, quien nos comparte cómo el deporte marcó cada etapa de su vida. Desde sus inicios en el karate hasta su ingreso al Comité Olímpico Mexicano a los 13 años, Ady Jiménez recuerda la disciplina, los sacrificios y los sueños que la formaron como atleta. Entre anécdotas de infancia, frustraciones como perder un pase olímpico en 2004 y el retiro temporal que la alejó de la plataforma durante una década, la clavadista narra su sorprendente regreso: decretar antes de saltar, vencer el miedo y abrazar la adrenalina de los 20 metros de altura. Hoy, retirada oficialmente desde 2022, Ady busca dejar un legado a través de la nueva federación de clavados, convencida de que el miedo no es un obstáculo, sino un motor. Su historia es un viaje de resiliencia, pasión y amor absoluto por el deporte.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Deportes
programme.desc: Conversamos con Marco Navarro, ciclista de alto rendimiento y actual entrenador, quien abre su historia personal y profesional con honestidad, entrega y pasión. Desde sus primeras vueltas en bicicleta por el Bosque de Aragón en la Ciudad de México, hasta representar a México a nivel internacional, Marco comparte los desafíos de un camino marcado por la constancia, las carencias y el amor al deporte. Navarro relata cómo se forjó entre campeones, sin bicicleta propia y enfrentando lesiones, como la que lo dejó dos meses sin caminar después de una medalla. Reflexiona sobre el impacto del alto rendimiento, la rivalidad en la selección nacional, y su evolución como coach, guiando a nuevas generaciones. El episodio profundiza en lo que implica mantenerse en la cima y el valor de reinventarse, descubrimos a un hombre que transformó las caídas en impulso, y que hoy busca sembrar en otros la misma determinación que lo llevó a la élite.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Deportes
programme.desc: Conversamos con El Coreanito Mateos, ex-boxeador y ahora entrenador, quien comparte su inspiradora trayectoria desde una infancia difícil hasta convertirse en uno de los referentes del boxeo mexicano. Desde su primer encuentro con un gimnasio a los 13 años hasta ganar el prestigioso torneo Guantes de Oro en 1994, Mateos nos relata cómo la disciplina, la pasión y el sacrificio definieron su carrera. El Coreanito nos lleva al corazón del ring: sus mejores peleas, los retos de mantenerse en forma, las derrotas y victorias que marcaron su vida.

programme.desc: Platicamos con Omar Villarreal, mejor conocido como "Villa Villa", reportero y comentarista deportivo cuya pasión por el futbol lo llevó de jugar en su infancia a convertirse en una de las caras jóvenes de TV Azteca Deportes. Fanático declarado de las Chivas, comparte cómo nació su afición, la emoción de ver a su equipo campeón y la adrenalina de reportear desde la cancha. Con humor, anécdotas y mucha pasión por el futbol, Villa Villa demuestra que el periodismo deportivo es un sueño alcanzable cuando se combina disciplina, entrega y amor por el juego.

programme.desc: Platicamos con Max Barrera, patinador profesional con más de 20 años de trayectoria, sobre lo que realmente implica dedicarse al skateboarding. Max nos comparte cómo se entrena el cuerpo y la mente para dominar trucos, superar el miedo y mantenerse constante en una disciplina que exige creatividad, paciencia y mucha resistencia. Hablamos del proceso detrás de las acrobacias, de cómo se construyen nuevos trucos y de lo que significa patinar desde la calle, con autenticidad, en un mundo donde el skate ya no es solo contracultura, sino también deporte, arte y forma de vida.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficción
programme.desc: Recibimos al irreverente y entrañable Mauricio Barrientos “Diablito”, actor, conductor, comediante y figura clave del entretenimiento en México. Entre risas, anécdotas y reflexiones honestas, Diablito nos muestra su lado más humano y auténtico, más allá del personaje que todos conocemos. Desde sus inicios en TV Azteca, hasta su participación en telenovelas, reality shows y programas de comedia, exploramos cómo ha evolucionado su carrera y su voz como artista. Un episodio entre la carcajada y la introspección, con un invitado que ha logrado mantenerse vigente rompiendo esquemas, sin perder su esencia.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle
programme.desc: Viajamos con Lety Zetune, experta en experiencias de lujo y agente de viajes de NUBA, nominada como una de las mejores agencias de México. Con ella, descubrimos por qué viajar no solo es una forma de conocer el mundo, sino también de reconectar contigo mismo.Desde los mejores destinos para una despedida de soltera, hasta los rincones más exóticos para una luna de miel, Lety nos guía a través de los secretos de planear un viaje inolvidable. En una charla cercana y divertida con nuestros conductores, derriba mitos sobre aerolíneas low cost, comparte tips para realizar presupuestos, revela sus destinos favoritos en México y nos cuenta cómo convirtió un viaje familiar en una búsqueda del tesoro en Machu Picchu.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficción
programme.desc: La talentosa actriz Majo Pérez nos abre las puertas de su mundo artístico y emocional. Majo relata cómo descubrió su pasión por la actuación, sus inicios en los escenarios y cómo el teatro se convirtió en su refugio. A lo largo de la entrevista, Majo reflexiona sobre los nervios que nunca desaparecen antes de salir a escena, los desafíos de interpretar personajes complejos, como su inolvidable papel de Sally Bowles en "Cabaret", y las experiencias incómodas que pueden surgir frente al público. Con sensibilidad, honestidad y carisma, Majo revela cómo ha roto moldes al interpretar roles tradicionalmente masculinos y cómo el escenario le ha permitido conocerse profundamente. Una conversación íntima y poderosa con una actriz que sigue desafiando los límites de la interpretación.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficción

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle
programme.desc: Nos acompaña Clara Corona de Lau, consultora en cultura organizacional, fundadora de Think Lynk y pionera en transformar la forma en que vivimos nuestro espacio laboral. Reconocida por múltiples presidentes de México y galardonada con el Premio Nacional del Empresario, Clara nos comparte su visión sobre liderazgo, bienestar y propósito dentro del entorno laboral. - Descubrimos los pilares que hacen de una empresa un lugar extraordinario: confianza, valores, empatía y una cultura sólida. También exploramos la historia de su reconocida empresa “Biomédica de Referencia”, ejemplo de excelencia y humanidad. - Un episodio inspirador que revela cómo la cultura organizacional no es un lujo, sino el corazón mismo del éxito.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficción
programme.desc: El reconocido director Chava Espinosa, nos revela los secretos detrás de la dirección de series y películas que han marcado tendencia en la televisión y el streaming. Con una trayectoria que inició desde el catering hasta llegar a la dirección de producciones icónicas como "Club de Cuervos", Chava comparte su evolución profesional con honestidad y buen humor. El episodio ofrece una mirada privilegiada al proceso creativo del director: desde el manejo de actores, el arte de construir comedia, hasta la presión de las premieres y el impacto del público en el resultado final. Además, reflexiona sobre el futuro del cine independiente, los cambios de la industria tras la pandemia y sus deseos de incursionar en géneros como la acción, el terror y la ciencia ficción. Una conversación dinámica, divertida e inspiradora con uno de los nombres clave en la nueva generación de directores en Latinoamérica.

programme.title: Romance En Valentine
programme.desc: Kennedy Blaine, una joven Californiana, hereda un rancho en el pequeño pueblo de Valentine, en Nebraska. Antes de vender la propiedad, Kennedy decide pasar unas semanas en el rancho y descubrir la historia de su familia. Confiando en la protección de Dios y en la ayuda de Derek Sterling, el administrador del rancho, se lanza a descubrir cuáles fueron los acontecimientos que obligaron a sus padres a dejar todo y mudarse a California.

programme.title: Rancho Esperanza
programme.desc: Una joven lo tiene todo: un hermoso rancho, un caballo llamado Faith y el amor de su familia. Pero tras la muerte de su padre, un militar, ella y su madre corren el riesgo de perder también el rancho familiar. Con un poco de ayuda de sus amigos y de su majestuoso caballo blanco, urden un plan para reunir el dinero suficiente para salvar el rancho mientras aprenden a no perder nunca la esperanza, a pesar de todo.

programme.title: El Sabor Del Amor
programme.desc: Una joven y talentosa sous chef en el mejor restaurante de la ciudad de Nueva York recibe una invitación para servir como jueza en un concurso de comida en Kansas, donde se vuelve a conectar con su novio de la universidad.

programme.title: Una Pizca De Amor
programme.desc: April viaja a Italia para salvar el contrato de su libro de cocina cuando sus recetas saludables son poco sabrosas. Por el camino descubre una nueva alegría y libertad en la vida y en la cocina, y también el amor.

programme.title: El Amor Te Encuentra En Mountain View
programme.desc: Después de enterarse de que le han confiado el cuidado de los hijos de su prima fallecida, una arquitecta se debate en concentrarse en su carrera y honrar el deseo de su prima.

programme.title: Por Amor Al Choclate
programme.desc: Mientras se prepara para el Festival Anual de los Maestros del Chocolate, los planes de Aria se ven sacudidos cuando pierde a su compañero poco antes de la competencia. Sin embargo, un apuesto padre soltero aparece para ayudarla a encontrar el ingrediente ganador.

programme.title: Perdidos En El Amor
programme.desc: Dos turistas en Turquía son abandonados por su autobús turístico tras visitar un yacimiento arqueológico. Sin sus pertenencias, deben regresar a Estambul improvisando con sus escasos medios.

programme.title: La Corriente Del Amor
programme.desc: La escritora Charlotte, una chica de ciudad de Chicago, se dirige a los parajes salvajes de Minnesota para escribir su nuevo libro. Su guía, Rob, duda de las habilidades de Charlotte. Sin embargo, se dan cuenta de que tienen más cosas en común y se enamoran.

programme.title: El Manual De La Felicidad
programme.desc: Cuando a Amy, una periodista de éxito, le encargan otro artículo de opinión sobre el excéntrico fundador de una empresa de bienestar, Paul, acepta a regañadientes con la esperanza de conseguir un ascenso. Pronto se da cuenta de que la felicidad llega ahora, no mañana.

programme.title: El Jardín Del Amor
programme.desc: La arquitecta paisajista Evie ha encontrado la horma de su zapato en su nuevo cliente, el testarudo arqueólogo Ryan, pero sus hijas, Zoey y Aria, adoran a Evie. Mientras las chicas ejecutan sus mejores planes para atrapar a los padres, Evie conoce una nueva faceta de Ryan, y se encuentra dividida entre su ex novio Mark y este apuesto padre soltero.

programme.title: Caballo Campeón
programme.desc: Una joven afligida trabaja en el rancho local propiedad de un magnate de los negocios, cuando llega un nuevo caballo y ella aprovecha la oportunidad para recuperar su fe entrenándolo para ganar.

programme.title: Inspirados Por El Amor
programme.desc: La tímida artista Isla se sorprende cuando su cuadro se vende accidentalmente al carismático vendedor Mark, cuyo jefe quiere encargarle una escultura. Mark, con la esperanza de impresionar a su jefe, convence a Isla y consigue que haga el trabajo, pero hay un problema... Isla nunca ha esculpido antes. Con el estímulo de Mark, la confianza de Isla florece y también su amor.

programme.title: Romance En Sugarcreek
programme.desc: En el tranquilo pueblo de Sugarcreek, Ohio, una mujer policía, Rachel Troyer, vive sobreprotegiendo a sus tías y al pequeño hotel que las ancianas administran. Un extraño, llamado Joe, llega con su pequeño hijo pidiendo albergue por una noche. Sospechando sobre la actitud de Joe, Rachel decide investigar el pasado del extraño, a pesar de la tremenda atracción que siente por él.

programme.title: La Bella y el Billonario
programme.desc: Addison choca con un billonario quisquilloso con el que tiene que trabajar para salvar el trabajo de su hermano.

programme.title: Amor Desencadenado
programme.desc: Sarah se entera de que su perro ha sido adoptado. Mientras ella y el nuevo dueño, Mike, luchan por la custodia, la pareja se enamora. Pero Mike tiene un secreto y Sarah se aleja. ¿Podrá prevalecer el amor verdadero?

programme.title: El Amor a través del Tiempo
programme.desc: Mientras inspecciona una antigua mansión británica por su potencial inmobiliario, Chelsea descubre un portal a través del tiempo que conecta con el dueño de la propiedad de finales de 1700. Cuando se produce un accidente, el caballero atraviesa el portal y queda atrapado en el presente.
