programme.title: Inspirados Por El Amor
programme.desc: La tímida artista Isla se sorprende cuando su cuadro se vende accidentalmente al carismático vendedor Mark, cuyo jefe quiere encargarle una escultura. Mark, con la esperanza de impresionar a su jefe, convence a Isla y consigue que haga el trabajo, pero hay un problema... Isla nunca ha esculpido antes. Con el estímulo de Mark, la confianza de Isla florece y también su amor.

programme.title: Romance En Sugarcreek
programme.desc: En el tranquilo pueblo de Sugarcreek, Ohio, una mujer policía, Rachel Troyer, vive sobreprotegiendo a sus tías y al pequeño hotel que las ancianas administran. Un extraño, llamado Joe, llega con su pequeño hijo pidiendo albergue por una noche. Sospechando sobre la actitud de Joe, Rachel decide investigar el pasado del extraño, a pesar de la tremenda atracción que siente por él.

programme.title: La Bella y el Billonario
programme.desc: Addison choca con un billonario quisquilloso con el que tiene que trabajar para salvar el trabajo de su hermano.

programme.title: Amor Desencadenado
programme.desc: Sarah se entera de que su perro ha sido adoptado. Mientras ella y el nuevo dueño, Mike, luchan por la custodia, la pareja se enamora. Pero Mike tiene un secreto y Sarah se aleja. ¿Podrá prevalecer el amor verdadero?

programme.title: El Amor a través del Tiempo
programme.desc: Mientras inspecciona una antigua mansión británica por su potencial inmobiliario, Chelsea descubre un portal a través del tiempo que conecta con el dueño de la propiedad de finales de 1700. Cuando se produce un accidente, el caballero atraviesa el portal y queda atrapado en el presente.

programme.title: Dos vivales en Fuerte Álamo
programme.desc: En plena Guerra Civil Americana, los soldados sicilianos Ciccio y Franco son encarcelados por deserción. Pero su destino da un giro inesperado cuando el ejército los recluta para una arriesgada misión de espionaje, confiando en que su torpeza aparente les permita engañar al enemigo. Una comedia bélica llena de enredos.

programme.title: Cassidy Red
programme.desc: Cassidy regresa a su pueblo natal del Viejo Oeste buscando vengar a su amante asesinado por su exprometido, un agente de la ley corrupto. Dividida entre amor, odio y justicia, su búsqueda se convierte en una batalla feroz por redención y verdad.

programme.title: Lo quiero muerto
programme.desc: La hermana de Clayton es violada y asesinada. ¡Es hora de una venganza letal!

programme.title: Vende la pistola y cómprate la tumba
programme.desc: Vende la pistola y cómprate la tumba - Sartana, cazarrecompensas y pistolero, es testigo del robo de un cargamento de oro.

programme.title: Tormenta en Arizona
programme.desc: Película de vaqueros publicada en 1956 dirigida por Joseph Kane y protagonizada por Skip Homeier: Tomenta en Arizona - Se descubre una rica veta de mineral en una mina de plata cerca de un pequeño pueblo. El corrupto alcalde casi consigue hacerse con el control de la mina.

programme.title: Ben y Charlie
programme.desc: Cuando, tras cumplir una condena de tres años, Ben Bellow sale de prisión, Charlie Logan lo está esperando para dejar claro que no quiere volver a saber nada de él. Sin embargo, el destino los obliga a reencontrarse una y otra vez: terminan robando un banco juntos y viviendo innumerables aventuras mientras se detestan.

programme.title: Salario para matar
programme.desc: Un codicioso mercenario polaco ayuda a un minero y a una campesina mientras lideran una revolución contra el opresivo gobierno mexicano y son perseguidos por un rival estadounidense.

programme.title: Garringo
programme.desc: De niño, Johnny vio morir a su padre a manos de soldados. Ahora, convertido en forajido, mata a soldados siempre que puede. El teniente Garringo recibe la misión de arrestarlo y llevarlo de regreso con vida. La caza se convierte en un juego peligroso entre el destino y la venganza.

programme.title: A través del huracán
programme.desc: Tres vaqueros, confundidos con miembros de una banda de forajidos, son perseguidos implacablemente por un pelotón.

programme.title: Texas El Rojo
programme.desc: La familia Sorenson es masacrada, al parecer por los indios. En el lugar de la matanza crece un pueblo, Gold Hill, dirigido por un grupo de hombres de negocios.

programme.title: ¡Caray, qué palizas!
programme.desc: Durante la Guerra Civil, el cabo McDonald recibe un valioso cargamento de oro, que decide guardar para recuperarlo luego. Él es el único que conoce el lugar donde está enterrado, pero es asesinado. Ahora, un teniente de la Unión y los dos hijos de McDonald compiten para descubrir dónde se encuentra el oro escondido.

programme.title: Persecución mortal
programme.desc: El pistolero Silver es contratado por un abogado para demostrar que su cliente, Chester Conway, es inocente del atraco a la taberna por el que ha sido condenado a la horca.

programme.title: Rebeldes en Canadá (Hudson River Massacre)
programme.desc: En la frontera del río Hudson, un grupo de cazadores de pieles se rebela contra el dominio inglés. Su líder, Víctor, secuestra a Ann, hija del despiadado terrateniente Sullivan, con la intención de negociar. Sin embargo, ambos terminan enamorándose y unen fuerzas para enfrentarse a la tiranía y luchar por su libertad.

programme.title: El forajido
programme.desc: Pat Garrett, Doc Holliday y Billy the Kid se enfrentan entre sí por la ley y las atenciones de la vivaz zorra campesina Río McDonald.

programme.title: Adiós, Texas
programme.desc: Un sheriff tejano y su hermano menor viajan a través de la frontera con México para enfrentarse al hombre que mató a su padre.

programme.title: Cuatro pistoleros rápidos (Four Fast Guns)
programme.desc: Un pistolero llega a la ciudad de Purgatory afirmando ser el “pacificador” esperado, aunque oculta haber causado la muerte del hombre cuya misión ahora asume. A cambio de una recompensa, decide enfrentarse al jefe criminal local, un líder en silla de ruedas que envía a varios asesinos para eliminarlo.

programme.title: Cuatro pistoleros de Santa Trinidad
programme.desc: El tráfico de armas con los indios, por un lado, y la adquisición de documentos relativos a la propiedad de una mina de oro, por otro, son los principales intereses de Quin y Gómez, los muy sospechosos huéspedes de la posada de Papá Martínez.

programme.title: Oeste Nevada Joe
programme.desc: Oeste Nevada Joe - Un pistolero superrápido es contratado para dirigir una explotación minera y ayudar a descubrir por qué están desapareciendo los beneficios.

programme.title: Joaquín Murrieta
programme.desc: La historia de Joaquín Murrieta, un bandido mexicano que aterrorizó California con su banda de asaltantes y asesinos durante la primera mitad del siglo XIX. Algunos lo veían como un forajido asesino, otros como el Robin Hood mexicano.

programme.title: 15 horcas para un asesino
programme.desc: Un número de matones de dos bandas diferentes evitan ser capturados por todos los medios. La ciudad prepara quince horcas, creyendo que su duro y cruel Sheriff se las arreglará para hacerlo. Los dos líderes de la banda se unen, muchos hombres caen en tiroteos, tres mujeres son asesinadas, pero el final es una sorpresa para todos.

programme.title: La ley de la fuerza
programme.desc: Una colonia cuáquera trata de salvar a las gigantescas secuoyas de un barón maderero.

programme.title: Recopilación Bonanza Episodios 25, 26, 27
programme.desc: Las aventuras del Salvaje Oeste de Ben Cartwright y sus hijos mientras dirigen y defienden su rancho de Nevada al tiempo que ayudan a la comunidad de los alrededores.

programme.title: El cuatrero errante
programme.desc: El hermano se enfrenta al hermano en esta historia de rancheros enfrentados en el viejo oeste.

programme.title: El jardín del diablo
programme.desc: Tres americanos navegan alrededor del cabo hasta los yacimientos de oro de California cuando son puestos en tierra durante varias semanas en un pequeño pueblo mexicano dormido.

programme.title: Deguello
programme.desc: Los bandidos de Ramón atacan Danger City en busca de un tesoro. Sin hallarlo, capturan a los hombres y amenazan con el «Deguello» si no reciben el dinero. Mujeres y niños, junto a cuatro forasteros decididos a detener a Ramón, luchan por salvar la ciudad.

programme.title: Winnetou El Guerrero
programme.desc: La construcción del Gran Ferrocarril del Oeste provoca un conflicto entre la compañía ferroviaria y las tribus indígenas. El criminal Santer intenta desviar la ruta hacia tierras apaches para explotar una mina de oro sagrada. Old Shatterhand, como técnico de mediciones, descubre el plan y busca a los apaches para evitar una guerra.

programme.title: El grito en la sangre
programme.desc: En algún lugar del interior de la Argentina, la creencia popular sostiene que cuando un hombre muere a traición, éste debe ser vengado por su primogénito, para que esa alma descanse en paz.

programme.title: Fuerte perdido
programme.desc: Una caravana de colonos viaja hacia el Territorio de Arizona en busca de nuevas tierras, atravesando peligrosos territorios apaches. Cuando Gerónimo y su tribu atacan, la expedición queda diezmada y los supervivientes se refugian en un fuerte aislado, donde deberán resistir un brutal asedio.

programme.title: Plazo para morir
programme.desc: Una historia sobre dos pistoleros, Duke y Steve. Steve está enamorado de la hija de Duke, pero Duke desaprueba la unión, imaginando una vida de penurias y peligro para la chica si se casa con Steve.

programme.title: Gente tranquila
programme.desc: En Moscú, una cadena de asesinatos desconcierta a la policía: en cada crimen muere el criminal que cometió el anterior, sin rastro del asesino. El comandante Sergey Odintsov, herido de gravedad y apartado del servicio, investiga por su cuenta, pero los problemas se acumulan: su hija está muy enferma y necesita medicinas caras, y el auto se dañó sin dinero para arreglarlo. Entonces llega un mensaje inesperado: su esposa Elena "gana la lotería"... con una condición: matar a alguien.

programme.title: Gente tranquila
programme.desc: Es evidente que el titiritero conoce bien a los participantes de su cruel juego: por dinero, están dispuestos a todo. Solo una joven parece haber terminado en este grupo por pura coincidencia.

programme.title: Gente tranquila
programme.desc: La oferta impacta a la joven, quien decide contarle todo a su esposo, que es policía.

programme.title: Gente tranquila
programme.desc: Ahora deben encontrar al organizador antes de que ocurra otro asesinato. Para ello, necesitan descubrir qué relación tiene la protagonista con la persona que le han encargado matar. El problema es que ella no tiene la menor idea de quién es esa persona ni qué los une…

programme.title: Mi alma gemela
programme.desc: ¿Cuál es la mejor opción? ¿Un refugio familiar tranquilo o un romance apasionado? ¿Una esposa, con la que ha vivido durante décadas, o una joven amante? Después de pensarlo mucho, el protagonista de la película, Alexei, de 40 años, opta por rehacer su vida...

programme.title: Mi alma gemela
programme.desc: Alexei confiesa su infidelidad y deja a Vera. Se casa con Marina, pero pronto conoce a otra mujer, Varvara, con quien siente una conexión profunda.

programme.title: Mi alma gemela
programme.desc: Alexei busca a Varvara y se enamora de ella. Marina descubre su romance y le envía fotos comprometedoras, desatando una crisis.

programme.title: Mi alma gemela
programme.desc: Marina exige el divorcio. Alexei encuentra en casa de Varvara objetos de su antiguo hogar con Vera y descubre una impactante verdad.

programme.title: Belleza
programme.desc: Anna Koroleva, la mujer más bella de la ciudad, ha aprendido a vivir rodeada de admiradores que solo ven su belleza. El bandido Zhukov, rechazado por ella, contrata matones para darle una lección... pero Andrei Savin la defiende, y Anna se enamora de él. Furioso, Zhukov descubre que ella está embarazada y asegura ante Andrei que el hijo es suyo. Herida por su desconfianza, Anna, por orgullo, confirma la mentira: él la abandona, y ella aborta. Si supiera a dónde la llevaría su orgullo...

programme.title: Belleza
programme.desc: Andrei cree la mentira de Zhukov sobre el hijo de Anna, y ella rompe con él y aborta. Udalov mata a Gushin, quien alcanza a revelarle su nombre a Andrei. Al ver a Andrei consolar a Natasha, hija de Gushin, Anna cree que ya no la ama e intenta suicidarse; su amiga Masha la salva. Por venganza, acepta casarse con Maks, el médico que la atendió. Udalov, mientras tanto, monta en Rusia adopciones ilegales de niños extranjeros con ayuda de María Serguéievna, directora del hospital materno-infantil.

programme.title: Belleza
programme.desc: Andrei se casa con Natasha, feliz de cumplir un amor de siempre. Cuando el mafioso 'El Amo' exige a Maks pagar una deuda que amenaza su negocio, Anna se vuelve su amante para salvarlo. Vadim, amigo de Andrei, llega investigando a Udalov por tráfico de niños, y planean atraparlo juntos. Anna y Andrei se reencuentran y el amor renace, pero el embarazo de Natasha le impide dejarla. Tras discutir con él, Anna sube a un taxi cuyos pasajeros, drogados, intentan abusar de ella; en la lucha, uno muere.

programme.title: Belleza
programme.desc: Maks se divorcia de Anna y, aprovechando su detención, la deja sin nada; Andrei intercede ante el padre del joven fallecido para lograr su liberación, pues es inocente. Vadim invita a Andrei a Moscú para abrir una agencia de detectives, y Natasha lo acompaña, aunque su matrimonio se deteriora porque él no logra olvidar a Anna. En la estación, Anna salva de un intento de asesinato a Udalov: "El Amo" había enviado a un sicario para matarlo por no compartir las ganancias del tráfico de niños.

programme.desc: Andrei cree la mentira de Zhukov sobre el hijo de Anna, y ella rompe con él y aborta. Udalov mata a Gushin, quien alcanza a revelarle su nombre a Andrei. Al ver a Andrei consolar a Natasha, hija de Gushin, Anna cree que ya no la ama e intenta suicidarse; su amiga Masha la salva. Por venganza, acepta casarse con Maks, el médico que la atendió. Udalov, mientras tanto, monta en Rusia adopciones ilegales de niños extranjeros con ayuda de María Serguéievna, directora del hospital materno-infantil.

programme.title: Belleza
programme.desc: Andrei se casa con Natasha, feliz de cumplir un amor de siempre. Cuando el mafioso 'El Amo' exige a Maks pagar una deuda que amenaza su negocio, Anna se vuelve su amante para salvarlo. Vadim, amigo de Andrei, llega investigando a Udalov por tráfico de niños, y planean atraparlo juntos. Anna y Andrei se reencuentran y el amor renace, pero el embarazo de Natasha le impide dejarla. Tras discutir con él, Anna sube a un taxi cuyos pasajeros, drogados, intentan abusar de ella; en la lucha, uno muere.

programme.title: Belleza
programme.desc: Maks se divorcia de Anna y, aprovechando su detención, la deja sin nada; Andrei intercede ante el padre del joven fallecido para lograr su liberación, pues es inocente. Vadim invita a Andrei a Moscú para abrir una agencia de detectives, y Natasha lo acompaña, aunque su matrimonio se deteriora porque él no logra olvidar a Anna. En la estación, Anna salva de un intento de asesinato a Udalov: "El Amo" había enviado a un sicario para matarlo por no compartir las ganancias del tráfico de niños.

programme.title: Belleza
programme.desc: Anna Koroleva, la mujer más bella de la ciudad, ha aprendido a vivir rodeada de admiradores que solo ven su belleza. El bandido Zhukov, rechazado por ella, contrata matones para darle una lección... pero Andrei Savin la defiende, y Anna se enamora de él. Furioso, Zhukov descubre que ella está embarazada y asegura ante Andrei que el hijo es suyo. Herida por su desconfianza, Anna, por orgullo, confirma la mentira: él la abandona, y ella aborta. Si supiera a dónde la llevaría su orgullo...

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Mark Peterson's South African journey continues as he moves into the historic Orange Free State. After incredible hunts in the Eastern Cape and Northern Cape, Mark is shifting his focus to two unique and challenging species: Mouflon and Feral Goat. Join Mark as he navigates the diverse terrain of the Orange Free State, putting his skills to the test in pursuit of these wary and elusive animals. Navigating the region’s expansive plateaus, Mark must rely on his glassing skills and long-range accuracy to secure these elusive trophies. This film features an 820 Yard Shot with his Gunwerks 300PRC - by far the longest shot Mark has ever done on a live animal! This is a prime testimony for Gunwerks' Long Range University.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Mark is wrapping up his Argentina hunt and heading to Entre Rios to track down the final two birds on his list: the Rock Pigeon and the Eared Dove. This area is home to over 10 million birds, making it a prime hunting ground. With flocks of pigeons and doves filling the skies, Mark is set for a fast-paced, action-packed finish to his hunt—a perfect end to an unforgettable adventure.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: As an avid bird hunter who grew up sharing his passion with his dad, Mark Peterson has traveled the globe pursuing his favorite game. After completing the North America Upland Slam and the New Zealand Wingshooting Slam both in a single season, he’s setting his sights on the South America Upland Slam.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: On day three of Mark Peterson’s South America Upland Slam adventure, the guys are snowed in while waiting to head to La Pampa, where the weather promised to be much better. After a tense wait for the go-ahead to fly out, they finally touched down in La Pampa and headed straight to the field. There, the grasslands and scattered thickets provide the perfect habitat for Bushed Tinamou, known for their elusive nature and penchant for hiding among dense underbrush. Day four is dedicated to hunting these Tinamou, with Mark eager to track them in their natural habitat. On day five, their focus shifts to Pigeons, where they set up decoys along the edge of a cut cornfield. The anticipation of drawing in flocks makes for an incredible hunt and Mark can’t wait to see what the day will bring.

Gary checks off a bucket list item by catching a sturgeon and we learn more about his time as a Vietnam Prisoner of war for over 4 years. We also share Sam Birrenkott’s experience as an AHO Ambassador and the time her and her family have devoted in the woodshop for our nations heros!...Sam also catches the BIGGEST fish EVER on AHO TV!!

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: Some mornings just remind you why we do this. Even better, we got to share it with a great friend, and that’s what makes hunts like this truly special. This is what turkey hunting is all about — good friends, beautiful mornings, and chasing longbeards in God’s country.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: We are blessed for the opportunity to follow along the guys from Trinity Oaks for Bucks for the Brave. The men and women that served in our armed services and as first responders, had jobs that required the, to be willing to sacrifice their own lives every day, in order to protect or save someone else's. Not many of us can say that, nor understand what that truly means. The things they've had to see, and the sacrifices they've made in their daily lives, can have a profound impact on them. Trinity Oaks' Bucks for the Brave platform allows the loved ones and communities that support these heroes to share their stories and unite us all in honoring and recognizing their service to our great nation. We are proud to continue to be a part of this incredible program, getting these heroes in the outdoors for the hunt of a lifetime.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: We’re kicking off a special weekend at Legends Ranch in Bitely, Michigan — bringing together two groups connected by a shared respect for the outdoors. Legends Ranch has always stood for - strong conservation values, and when you combine that with the work being done by the SCI Foundation and Sables, it sets the tone for something bigger than just a hunt. Sables members are deeply involved in shaping the future of hunting — reaching into - classrooms, working with young people, collaborating with wildlife professionals, and engaging leaders at both the state and national level. Their efforts are centered on helping others understand wildlife diversity, the principles behind the North American Model of Wildlife Conservation, and the role hunting plays in maintaining - balance in the wild. They’re also helping keep the tradition alive — showing that hunting still has a strong place in today’s culture and communities. With that kind of purpose behind it, this weekend is about more than time in the field — it’s about continuing something that matters.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: Throughout the years, our friendships have been forged in deer camps across the country, and this week is a continuation of some of those times. This week, we have Dave Peterson and Mike Winkler from Do All Outdoors and Jurassic Rock in camp with us. When all is said and done, we even got to do a little hunting ourselves and create more memories that will last a lifetime

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: It’s that time again—when the boys from StruttinBuck load up and head out of Arkansas, bound for Fairfield, Texas and the FE Hill Ranch. Another year, another hunt, and another chapter in a tradition that’s grown into something far bigger than the hunt itself. This annual father-son trip is built on early mornings, shared stories, and moments that stick with you long after the season ends. It’s the memories made over the years that keep calling them back—and this year will be no different.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: This is the story of how FE Hill ranch got it's start. From its inception, FE Hill has created opportunities for people to experience the outdoors and create memories. For us, it has created a tradition of Fathers and Sons hunting together.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: We’re back with Double T Outfitters for this episode of Storytellers, filmed at the beautiful Las Lagunas Ranch in South Texas! - This hunt was one to remember as we spent time with the Price family, including Logan—our Show Your Skull Showdown winner from last season! From unforgettable hunts and incredible wildlife to evenings around hunting camp with amazing people, this trip was filled with memories that will last a lifetime. A huge thank you to Double T Outfitters for your incredible hospitality and for your continued support of TTHA. Partnerships like yours help make experiences like this possible. This episode is packed with great hunting, genuine friendships, and the stories that make the outdoors so special.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: From time to time you have moments that will change the way think about something. That is what happened for us while hunting the Scimitar Oryx with Republic Outdoors. Hunting is more than harvesting animals, it’s conservation, and in this story, we learn how a species nearly extinct gets another chance to live.

programme.title: Blair Wiggins Outdoors

programme.title: Blair Wiggins Outdoors

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff join a local biologist searching for a white rhino whose tracking collar has failed, leaving it exposed to poachers. As they follow its trail through the African bush, the search builds toward a heart-pounding encounter that none of them will ever forget.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle takes to the water in a way few anglers dare, fishing from a Sea-Doo in search of the ancient lake sturgeon, a species that’s been around since the age of the dinosaurs and can live over 100 years. Hooking into one of North America’s largest freshwater fish from a personal watercraft proves to be a challenge unlike any other.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff embark on a 20-day mission into the Everglades to find the invasive pythons that are plaguing the ecosystem. These apex predators have eliminated more than 90% of fur-bearing animals in their new home. Can they turn the tide, or is the Everglades already lost?

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff get bit by catfish in Southern Oklahoma with YouTuber Nate Williams of Adrenaline Rush Adventures while using the most primitive fishing tactic - hand fishing. programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: A "Best of..." episode spanning the past 4 seasons of Winchester Life.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew heads to Colorado to field test Winchester’s new Supreme Long Range ammunition—engineered for hunters who demand precision at extended distances. Featuring the BC Max bullet, built with a high ballistic coefficient, heat-resistant tip, and match-grade components, this round is designed for flatter trajectories, reduced wind drift, and devastating terminal performance. - After confirming zero and studying real-world drop and wind deflection at the range, the team heads into Colorado’s rugged backcountry in pursuit of mule deer and elk. With fresh snow, steep canyons, and long shooting lanes, the terrain offers the perfect proving ground to see how the new bullet performs under pressure. - From close-range opportunities to challenging cross-canyon shots, this hunt puts the technology—and the hunters—to the test in one of the West’s toughest landscapes.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, Winchester athletes Kim Rhode and Desiree Edmonds share what it takes to compete at the highest level of clay target shooting. From the pressure of national competition to the routines that build confidence, they reveal how preparation, mental focus, and years of dedication lead to success. The transcript emphasizes that managing pressure is a learned skill, supported by consistent routines and trust in dependable equipment like Winchester AA shotshells. - As the two champions train, mentor the next generation, and reflect on the journeys that shaped their careers, the episode celebrates more than trophies. With Kim's Olympic legacy and Desi's Hall of Fame induction, the passion, perseverance, and commitment to excellence that continue to inspire shooters across the country.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, Winchester team members and employees meet up at the Keefer Brothers property in Missouri for a multi day deer camp. programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
programme.desc: In the heart of the Zambezi Delta, a team of conservationists have overseen one of the largest range expansions of African lions in modern times. From a reintroduction of 24 lions in 2018, today the population is more than a hundred.

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
programme.desc: For many protected reserves across Africa, the elephant populations are expanding, and this comes with a critical problem: what happens to the elephants when an area reaches carrying capacity? programme.title: Ollie! The Boy Who Became What He Ate
programme.desc: Ollie is a 6-year-old with a massive imagination, often lost in his own world - flipping, sliding, climbing and rocket-blasting through the house, practicing at being the master of all things. But even masters need to stop and refuel. When meals or snack time interrupt Ollie’s play, he finds himself confronted with the real challenge of childhood; trying new food. To escape his predicament, Ollie uses his magic spoon to transport himself, along with his sister Poppy, and her stuffy Nummy, to a food planet filled with adventure and the very food Ollie stuck his spoon into.

programme.title: Heroes of Envell
programme.desc: Present days. Saint Petersburg. Four friends – Art, Kira, Phil and Vic are the coolest gamers in school. Eventually they find a suspicious laptop with «Heroes of Envell» game installed on it. Turns out that this very laptop is a portal to another dimension, a game realm which is full of adventures and real-life danger. The game realm is a blend of medieval, steampunk and futurism. You never know what really awaits our heroes. Just like the design of the game, the game logic is very unpredictable. You start with a quest and then it becomes a race right until it all grows into a tricky brainteaser. But be sure about one thing – there is no boring or easy way in here. programme.title: Camp Cool Kids
programme.desc: At their summer camp competition games, Spence and his big brother Zach find themselves on opposing teams: it’s the dweebs against the bullies. Can Spence make new friends, overcome his fears, stand up to the bullies and win a trophy in the process?

programme.title: Paper Tales
programme.desc: Animation series “Paper Tales” narrate to children audience in fascinating way amusing adventures of paper animals – a moose named Aristotle and a woodpecker named Knock-Knock – in paper land where everything is made only from paper. Merry adventures come together with entertaining insets “for crafty hands” when the audience learns how to produce all cartoon characters using paper, cardboard, scissors and glue. The project is supported with the site where all flat patterns are provided with the advices how to manufacture the paper world items.This is the way spectator gets involved into a peculiar game that brings out creative work and development of many useful practical skills, distracting kids from permanent attachment to a computer. The “Paper Tales” project is a fascinating and helpful alternative to computer-oriented pastime. The whole cartoon is accompanied by off-screen narrator’s text and exuberant flow of gags. Each episode is planned to last for 5 minutes (a version without insets – 4 minutes). Technique of performance is 3D computer graphics imitating paper application work.

programme.title: Future Card Buddyfight
programme.desc: It is the year 2030, and the stage is the capital of Japan, Chou-Tokyo. Through "Buddyfight", humans have started cultural interactions with residents from other worlds called "Affinity Dimensions". Buddyfight is a game with selected humans as the "Buddyfighter", and residents from the other world as the partner (known as "Buddy Monster"). These battles have high significance and sometimes it is even used to decide the fate of a nation, and naturally there are those who seek to use the Buddy Monsters for evil purposes.

programme.title: Sox A Family's Best Friend
programme.desc: When two families come together by marriage, the new brothers struggle to unite and are eventually brought together by a magical dog named Sox.

programme.title: VIP Pets
programme.desc: We are the VIP Pets! The coolest pets with a passion for hair! We are best friends and together we will discover lots of beautiful hairstyles and go on exciting adventures!

programme.title: Valentina
programme.desc: Valentina and her friends are fun-loving, teenage girls. They shop, they have sleepovers, and they dream about their first true love.

programme.title: Nessie & Me
programme.desc: A 9-year-old boy moves to a lakeside village and befriends a captain who claims a mythical sea creature named Nessie lives in their peaceful waters. When Nessie proves to be real, the boy embarks on a special mission to save the town!

programme.title: Winx Club
programme.desc: Winx Club is a fantasy saga revolving around six fairies and their adventures. The protagonists Bloom, Stella, Flora, Aisha, Tecna and Musa live their daily life on Magix world, among lessons, loves, quarrels and moments of strong friendship. At any moment, when needed, they can transform into super-heroines, ready to defeat evil and save who is in danger.

programme.title: Woodventures
programme.desc: "Woodventures" is an animated series for preschool children. The main characters are wooden toys: Kitty Meow, Doggy Woof-Woof, Piggy Oink, Horsey Yee-Ho-Ho and Elephant Pawoo. The toys live in a small wooden town (the prototype of a child's play room). Every toy has its own unique personality and reacts to different circumstances appropriately. With the help of the invisible narrator, the toys, along with the audience solve different tasks, play and take part in adventures. "Woodventures" is a musical series with lots of songs and dances. Some of the songs represent our characters and appear in each series, and some of the songs are related to the events in the series, so it is only found in that particular episode.Each episode presents a playful and learning environment.

programme.title: Cutie Cubies
programme.desc: An animation series about the adventures of four aliens - Cubies: Captain, Boatswain, Navigator, and Doctor. Having arrived on our planet and disguised as representatives of the local flora and fauna of the cubic form: a yellow chicken, a red rabbit, a blue aquarium and a bush of green grass, they are learning the diverse phenomena of our planet Earth.

programme.title: Bat Pat
programme.desc: The series follows the comedy adventures of Bat Pat and the Silver brothers Martin, Leo and Rebecca as they unravel mysteries and cross paths with supernatural creatures of the night that lurk, haunt, shriek and dig themselves up in every dark corner of their home in Fogville, a small town that seems to be the center of all things weird in the world, a veritable magnet to ghosts, mummies, witches, creatures, werewolves and things that go bump in the night. Bat Pat will prove that the supernatural isn’t always evil but just misunderstood. Our heroes will come to understand something important: the supernatural “bad guys” are not really bad, but normal people whose actions are misunderstood by the more inhabitants of Fogville and what they really want is... just help!

Timmy is going to Nursery! Self-willed and naughty Timmy is going to have to learn how to share things with other youngsters and think about their feelings – not just his. Timmy is a gifted little footballer who needs to learn that it’s not enough to kick the ball – you have to pass it too. Harriet Heron and Osbourne Owl, who run the Nursery are going to have their hands full, but Timmy gets it right in the end with a little help from his friends of the furry, feathery and spikey type.

Su relación evolucionará de la desconfianza y el miedo hacia la compasión, la ternura y el amor.

programme.title: HUNABKU
programme.desc: Federico, Mabel y su hijo Lucas dejan su vida en Buenos Aires y se mudan al sur, seducidos por una prometedora oferta de trabajo para Federico.

programme.title: HUACHICOLERO
programme.desc: Lalo es un adolescente de catorce años que, desde una vision ingenua, se involucra en el mundo clandestino del robo de gas al intentar conseguir dinero para comprarle un regalo a Ana y ganarse su corazon.

programme.title: DIAS BORROSOS
programme.desc: Emilia, contemplando la maternidad en un mundo pospandemico, forma una conexion inesperada con su deprimido vecino anciano, Felipe.

programme.title: DOS ORIENTALES
programme.desc: Dos Orientales recorren el mundo con musica, recuerdos y alegria.

programme.title: Aurora Boreal (Mi Ultimo d¡a)

programme.title: Brujas del Cordobazo
programme.desc: El Cordobazo fue una manifestación popular que contó con un impulso fundamental para la sociedad argentina: la unidad de trabajadores y estudiantes contra la dictadura militar de Juan Carlos Onganía.

programme.title: Bruma
programme.desc: Este es el recorrido por la vida de un hombre que se hizo una celebridad para la salsa colombiana: Jairo Varela.

programme.title: Asia Unplated
programme.desc: Singaporean cuisine is widely influenced by several ethnic groups that make up the population. Finaly, Diana cooks one of her favourite ‘Hokkien Mee’, a simple noodle dish created using a homemade prawn stock.

programme.title: UpRooted With Sarah Sharratt

While the menu is about embracing the new, Sarah tries to maintain some Christmas traditions from her childhood growing up in America. programme.title: Ladies Buchonas
programme.desc: Laura es una chica guapa y pretenciosa que suele ir a lugares frecuentados por hombres de la mafia. programme.title: La banda del Mochaorejas

programme.title: Boonie Bears : The Big Shrink
programme.desc: After purchasing a mysterious shrink ray machine, Vick accidentally shrinks Briar, Bramble, and himself. The tiny team must put aside their differences and embark on one big journey to restore their size and their friendship.

programme.title: Mission to the Moon
programme.desc: In the international race to the moon, the Norwegian mission is led by brilliant inventor Reodor from the village of Flaklypa. With Louis the Magpie as the brave astronaut, what could possibly go wrong? Quite a bit, actually – on the daring mission, secret passengers are discovered, hidden agendas are revealed, and nothing seems to work out the way it was planned. Louis and his friend Luca the Hedgehog are in for some surprises on their trip to the moon. The third film in the stop-motion trilogy featuring the beloved characters from the Flaklypa universe.

programme.title: Spy Cat
programme.desc: Four crazy anti-heroes, one pawsome adventure. Join special-agent Marnie and her friends as they team up and fight crime. Spoiled and innocent, chubby house cat Marnie lives a comfortable and pampered life in the Sunshine household. She has never ventured outside the family home and only knows about the real world through her favourite detective, crime TV-shows.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy Lupin manages to convince the pack elders to let him sit Howlington Academy’s entrance test. Freddy must use all his poodle wits- and his best friend Batty’s help!- to win a place at the historically wolf-only academy.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: It’s the first day of school, and Freddy immediately comes into conflict with bully Ivan, who blackmails him into stealing the sacred moonstone! But when Batty is exposed to the moonstone, she’s turned into a human girl!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy attempts to teach Batty how to be human, while searching for a cure for her new form. A class assignment to capture the mysterious ‘Golden Horn’ and prove who the ‘alpha’ wolf is goes awry when a wilderwolf attacks!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy becomes convinced that there’s a wilderwolf at Howlington, and launches a daring investigation to prove that it’s the school accountant, Mr Sminch. Howlington gets a new teacher, the super cool and charming Ric Rawls.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: The kids are struck down by a flea infestation, and Freddy and Batty are tasked with tracking down the mysterious Doog, keeper of the Fleaminator, the most powerful flea treatment known to dog, before they’re all expelled!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: The kids head out on their first excursion to Night Patrol HQ. Freddy gets pulled into Scarlet’s world as she gets closer to the truth about werewolves and the two bond when they get stuck in the forest while tracking a wolf.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: It’s Howloween, and Howlington is on lockdown. But when the students stage a play that goes wrong and the lockdown is disrupted, it will be up to the kids to save the grown-ups from themselves - including Principal Pincus!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy and Ivan have failed their runes exam and have to do it over - or they won’t be allowed to attend the Doom Wolves concert. But their study session ends up putting themselves, and the Doom Wolves, in grave danger!

programme.title: Back to the Sea
programme.desc: When little fish Kevin is swept up in a net and taken from his home in the vast oceans to the small glass fish tank of a restaurant, he must find a way to escape and make his way back home.

programme.title: Racetime

programme.title: Son of Bigfoot

programme.title: Ziggy Marley - Live at the Filmore
programme.desc: The Fillmore Auditorium is a historic concert hall in San Francisco, California. Founded by Bill Graham, it was named after being located originally on the corners of Fillmore Street and Geary Boulevard.

programme.title: A-ha: Unplugged - Summer Solstice
programme.desc: Unplugged - Summer Solstice is the fourth live album, and the first in acoustic format, from the Norwegian band A-ha.

programme.desc: Born to Die is the second album by singer-songwriter Lana Del Rey, and the first to be officially released on January 27, 2012 and that would lead to global success; In countries such as the United Kingdom the album was the best selling of that year.

programme.title: Jack Johnson - Live in London 2013
programme.desc: Filmed at Roundhouse, London, this concert film will give all fans a spectacular Live experience from start to finish. Classic Jack Johnson featuring unforgettable version of his hits: 'Better Together', 'Good People', 'Taylor' and many more.

programme.title: Paul Simon - Live in New York City
programme.desc: During the first leg of Paul Simon's triumphant, 2011 U.S. tour, he thrilled hometown fans with a special club performance at New York City's historic Webster Hall.

programme.title: Imagine Dragons - Live At The Moody Theater
programme.desc: Filmed at The Moody Theater, Texas, this concert film will give all fans a spectacular Live experience from start to finish. Classic Imagine Dragons featuring unforgettable version of their hits: 'Demons', 'Radioactive' and many more.

programme.title: Carlos Santana - Greatest Hits: Live at Montreux 2011
programme.desc: Masterfully filmed in Montreux in July of 2011, this epic show captures the band performing their classics hits such as Jingo, Evil Ways and Black Magic Woman their later No.1 hits Maria, Maria and Smooth. programme.title: The Doobie Brothers - Live At Wolf Trap

programme.title: MisterWives: The Don’t Look Down Tour: Live from The Wiltern
programme.desc: Indie-pop band MisterWives close out The Don’t Look Down Tour with an electrifying, sold-out performance at The Wiltern in Los Angeles. Fronted by Mandy Lee, the group performs a dynamic mix of hits and new songs from their album Nosebleeds, blending soaring vocals, raw emotion, and vibrant stage energy. The night captures the band’s message of resilience, growth, and celebration as they connect with fans in a transformative live experience.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Third Eye Blind frontman Stephan Jenkins joins Joel Madden to discuss songwriting, creativity, and the band’s upcoming album. Jenkins opens up about perfectionism, the struggle to finish lyrics, and the human element that drives his music. He also shares insights on producing, the influence of Eric Valentine, and gearing up for The Summer Gods Tour with Yellowcard and A R I Z O N A.

programme.title: Jimmy Eat World: 20th Anniversary of “Futures” Live From Phoenix
programme.desc: Jimmy Eat World return to their hometown for a one-night celebration of the 20th anniversary of Futures, performing the album front to back at The Van Buren in Phoenix, Arizona. Featuring fan-favorite tracks (“Futures,” “Just Tonight…,” “Work,” “The World You Love,” “Pain,” “Drugs or Me”) and special hometown moments from the band.

programme.title: James Taylor: Live at the Beacon Theatre

programme.title: Artist Friendly

Daryl reflects on three decades of genre-defying music, the freedom he’s always pursued as an artist, the self-doubt and restlessness that shaped his work, and how fatherhood became the most grounding and fulfilling experience of his life.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Grammy Award-winning singer-songwriter Joss Stone joins Joel Madden for a candid conversation about growing up in the music industry, her love of horror movies, and the process of creating a live album.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Sleep Theory frontman Cullen Moore joins Joel Madden to talk about his journey from serving in the U.S. Army to fronting one of modern rock’s fastest-rising bands. Moore reflects on his Memphis roots, discovering his sound, and how TikTok helped launch Sleep Theory to viral success. The two explore discipline, creativity, and how music became Moore’s true “Plan A.”

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Grammy Award–winning country singer-songwriter Lainey Wilson joins Joel Madden to talk about growing up in rural Louisiana, chasing her Nashville dreams, and building a career through perseverance and purpose. They discuss her new album Whirlwind, the balance between ambition and well-being, and the lessons that come from hardship, therapy, and self-discovery.

programme.title: Gil Scott-Heron - Black Wax
programme.desc: BLACK WAX is a musical-political entertainment film produced and directed by Robert Mugge. It centers on the late African American poet-singer-songwriter Gil Scott-Heron - the man Melody Maker called the most dangerous musician alive and many dubbed the forefather of rap music - and his Midnight Band.

programme.title: SPIN COVER STORY yungblud: "walk with me"
programme.desc: If Yungblud led a cult, many would join - even those who fancy themselves hard to persuade. He has an orbit, an aura, an affability that is borderline intoxicating. You can experience it for yourself during our walk with Yungblud through the Sunset Strip, from the Viper Room to the Rainbow Bar and Grill – watch Yungblud share some incredible stories and a Dr Pepper

programme.title: Looking for Johnny: The Legend of Johnny Thunders
programme.desc: Johnny Thunders was the legendary hard-living rock n roll guitarist who inspired glam-metal, punk and the music scene in general. Looking For Johnny is a 90-minute film that documents Thunders career from his beginnings to his tragic death in 1991. The film examines his career as a member of the New York Dolls, the punk scene with The Heartbreakers in New York City and London and much more.

programme.title: SPIN Presents: Trailers From Hell
programme.desc: From Amadeus the worlds first rockstar to The Beatles and Elvis, Hollywood has always remembered "When Rock Was Young"

programme.title: String Theory: Guitar Obsessed
programme.desc: String Theory: Guitar Obsessed delivers a humorous but reverent look at why we love the guitar. Among the 24 distinguished people in the film: Execs from 5 major manufactures, 4 well known internet instructors and retail guitar store owners in the USA and the UK...plus distinguished professors and even the former Deputy Director of the FBI. If you play guitar, you will want to see this movie.

programme.title: SPIN x Fire: Free Speech + Other Dirty Words

programme.desc: Before Beyoncé, Madonna and Prince - there was Betty Davis

programme.title: Get Thrashed Around The World
programme.desc: Stellar metal bands came out of Germany, UK, France, Brazil, Canada, Denmark, Sweden, Norway, Canada, and more as part of the Thrash Metal movement. Members of bands like Slayer, Metallica, Slipknot, and Exodus reminisce about their favorite bands and the best musicians of the era. A virtual encyclopedia of metal bands that toured the world, but that fans may have forgotten or can now discover.

programme.title: SPIN Presents: Trailers From Hell

programme.title: LoudQUIETloud: A Film About the Pixies
programme.desc: loudQUIETloud follows the rehearsals and the warm-up shows for the full-fledged, sold-out Pixies reunion tour. It also catalogs, in the cinema-verite style of the Rolling Stones' Gimme Shelter, the less glamorous side of the touring band lifestyle, getting as close to this enigmatic act as anyone is ever likely to get. The Pixies have a once-in-a-lifetime chance at rock n roll redemption.

programme.title: SPIN Presents: Trailers From Hell
programme.desc: In the 1970's Hollywood began to release a whole new type of musical film. Bob Fosse, Hippies, and Jesus were the new stars in this adventurous period in cinema.

programme.title: Stiv: No Compromise No Regrets
programme.desc: Almost 30 years after Stiv's mysterious death in Paris, the Dead Boys have become the stuff of (Punk) legends but unsurprisingly, the story remains largely untold. How did this native from Girard, Ohio end up living the life of Riley in Paris, France' Was Stiv really hit by a car (or a taxi...) on that fateful day' Who was the real Stiv Bators' These are a few of the questions answered in STIV.

Y en Terranova, una fuga de combustible, un curso de supervivencia aleccionador y un trágico choque sacudieron a la tripulación de Turquía. Cuando los fuertes vientos brinden la ventana meteorológica tan esperada.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: La tripulación de Turquía hace el salto crítico sobre el Atlántico Norte. Pero en el camino a Portugal, un equipo se ve obligado a regresar. Sin potencia en un motor y sin forma de mantener la altitud, deben regresar a Santa María, donde el aeropuerto está en alerta de emergencia completa. Y Mikey y Scott buscan una nueva rampie, mientras que las esperanzas de Jeremy se desploman aún más.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Las tripulaciones C-46 y DC-4 compiten contra el deshielo primaveral para volar equipos mineros a una pista de aterrizaje en un lago congelado. Jeremy intenta alcanzar a sus compañeros rampies Audrey y Wilf. Y en el último tramo a Turquía, Arnie y Justin se enfrentan a algunos volcanes serios y al intenso tráfico aéreo del Mediterráneo.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Cuando su esposo renuncia después de un reventón con Joe, Kelly se pone en una posición terrible. ¿Se quedará en Buffalo o se irá? Scott recibe la noticia de que debe retirarse del vuelo para que otro copiloto pueda acelerar el paso al capitán. Él hace todo lo posible para asegurar una nueva carta, pero su rival también quiere volar el nuevo trabajo.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Después de la amarga partida de su esposo de Buffalo, Kelly tiene una confrontación que decide si ella también renunciará. Jeremy comete un error que podría terminar con su carrera en Buffalo. La escasez de gasolina de aviación trae una dosis de realidad aleccionadora a los McBryans. Y después de una visita de su madre, el destino le lanza a Scott una inesperada bola curva.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Joe pelea una demanda de Transport Canada contra la aerolínea.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Cuando un incendio mortal destruye un puesto de avanzada en el norte una semana antes de Navidad.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: La maldición del -40 golpea a los pilotos de Buffalo, Devan y Scott, en un vuelo por correo de alimentos.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Un enlace de ferry vital está caído, por lo que Buffalo organiza una campaña total para transportar 100,000 libras de productos.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: El mecánico crujiente Chuck lidera la lucha para preparar a los Electra para una misión de socorro en casos de desastre en Haití.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Una misión de varias paradas al Extremo Norte tiene a Devan, Scott y Adam enfrentando una serie de obstáculos de nudillos blancos.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Los jóvenes pilotos AJ y Andrew tienen la oportunidad de su vida de volar el magnífico DC-3.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: El piloto principal Arnie aterriza el DC-3 en una franja de arena casera en un refugio remoto.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Cuando las tormentas eléctricas y un motor tembloroso amenazan un alquiler de DC-3 a Whitehorse.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Joe y Mikey se dirigen a Coventry, Inglaterra, para explorar la posible compra de un turbohélice Electra.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Mientras entrena a los capitanes de bombas de agua para la próxima temporada de extinción de incendios.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Buffalo se mete en el negocio de las acrobacias aéreas cuando el veterano piloto Arnie vuela el DC-4.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Crítico de las muchas paradas y arranques en el programa de Electra, y frustrado con el drama constante en Buffalo.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Frustrada por su falta de vuelo y atrapada en una rutina como conductora de mensajería.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Cuando una avería en el ferry provoca una escasez de gasolina en Yellowknife.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Duane consigue un contrato enorme para el Electra y ejerce una enorme presión sobre el mecánico Adam.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
