But when their motorboat’s engine fails, they have to spend the night on the island: that night, when Rikki, Emma and Cleo are exploring the island, they fall into a mysterious cave.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: Little Elliot gets his big sister Emma to enter the Grand Sand Sculpture contest with him. Meanwhile Cleo’s day starts badly at the Oceanic Center: Mr. Lambert puts her in charge of the new intern - Miriam, the Mayor’s daughter and high school pest! Miriam lives up to her reputation, and submits Cleo to a series of capricious outbursts.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: During a scientific experiment conducted by Lewis out at sea, the three mermaids find a wooden statue of a white mermaid on the seafloor! Lewis discovers it’s the figurehead of a famous pirate galleon, the White Mermaid, which sank at sea without a trace! Rikki and Emma are thrilled, while Cleo is preoccupied by something else.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: Emma’s in a dilemma: handsome Byron has invited her to his birthday party on his uncle’s yacht. Her girlfriends tell her it’s no place for someone who transforms into a mermaid at the slightest drop of water. But Emma willfully goes along. Afraid she’ll do something silly, her girlfriends and Lewis join the party.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: A grand holiday resort on Mako Island? Its idyllic slopes covered with concrete and the volcanic lake inside the mountain, where the mermaids first transformed, converted into a swimming pool? Only Zane’s father could have dreamed up such a development. But Emma, Cleo and Rikki aren’t going to let this happen!

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: Emma loses her mermaid nature and her powers after touching some mysterious blue seaweed. Remembering what it’s like being “normal” - she used to be a passionate swimmer - she rejoins the synchronized swimming team, which is preparing a show for the Summer Solstice Festival.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: More and more plastic bags are polluting Dolphin City Bay, and the turtles mistake the bags for sea-sponges and suffocate on them. Our three mermaids, alerted by their friend Teddy the turtle, tackle the problem. After some unsuccessful attempts, they and Lewis decide to use stronger methods to stir up public opinion.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: In the aftermath of a violent storm, Dolphin City looks like a new Bermuda Triangle: boats mysteriously break down or sink in the bay. At the sight of hordes of journalists, the girls investigate, with Lewis’ help. They find out that a lightning bolt from the storm has activated mysterious crystals whose magnetic field disrupts navigation equipment.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: When Emma, Cleo and Rikki find out two superstars – Brad Patinson and Scarlett Belladonna - are shooting a film in Dolphin City, directed by the famous Martin Fabiola, they try anything to get on the set. Luckily Zane has been hired by the production! Only Rikki prefers to approach the stars in her own way – underwater of course!

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: Murray and Burke are inconsolable: their pal Danny the octopus has disappeared! By chance, Cleo finds out that he’s in fact been captured by the Oceanic Center, who are conducting scientific research. Murray puts pressure on the mermaids to get Danny out of there and bring him back to the sea. But Danny doesn’t want to go home.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: Why has a whale calf run aground on an isolated beach near Dolphin City? And what’s causing the girls’ migraines? Does it have anything to do with the dolphin twins’ bizarre sickness? During their investigations the mermaids come across a strange fishing boat using illegal technology: an extremely low-frequency military radar device.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: Burke the hammerhead shark has broken a tooth. To sooth the pain, he has to come up for air at the surface regularly: but in so doing, he involuntarily shows his fin. Before long a panic wave runs through the citizens of Dolphin City, who think they’ve got a dangerous shark on their hands.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: Rikki has to make up for her mistakes! Convinced that her father’s new girlfriend, Cathy, is dishonest, Rikki sabotages the dinner in which her father tried to ask Cathy for her hand in marriage. To bring the estranged sweethearts back together, Rikki absolutely has to recover the lost engagement ring, which fell into the sea during that tumultuous dinner.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: Worrying events agitate the little underwater community of the Bay: clownfish are inexplicably disappearing one after another. The mermaids try to get to the bottom of this mystery, to find their friend Ziggy, a little clownfish who’s among those missing.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: Cleo is down in the dumps: she might lose her job at the Oceanic Center, since she said she’s allergic to water, to avoid getting wet in front of Mr. Lambert. Swimming out at sea, she wanders into a strange stone circle – suddenly she wishes she could forget all about this mermaid business. Her wish comes true.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: It’s Valentines Day! Lewis and Abby spend the day together like sweethearts. Cleo goes crazy with jealousy. She finds out that Lewis has promised to tell Abby a huge secret. And what if – blinded by love – Lewis were to betray Cleo and her friends, by revealing that they are mermaids?! Emma, Cleo and Rikki have to get to the bottom of this

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: The inhabitants of the Bay are overwhelmed: one of the dolphin twins, Robby, has disappeared, captured by an unknown speedboat. Bernie calls on our three mermaids for help: the girls were walking around Dolphin City, which is all decked out for the carnival. But why would anyone kidnap a dolphin?

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: In her sleep Cleo creates huge spheres of water that float through the air in Dolphin City, causing chaos. This strange phenomenon is caused by her worries about her Dad, who is on a mission out at sea. And what if Cleo’s worries are real? What if her Dad really has fallen into the hands of dangerous outlaws involved in illegal fishing?

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: The girls find some turtle eggs on Dolphin City beach: they are too fragile to move, so they take turns watching over them till they hatch. But that's not counting with Miriam and Zane – who are having a beach party!! Meanwhile, underwater, Bernie, cannot bear all the noise and disruption his neighbors are making, and decides to leave his cave and go and stay elsewhere for a bit of a rest.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: The White Mermaid is in danger! Her sanctuary, the sunken galleon of Edward the Cruel, is about to be discovered by Stanley Finch, the famous explorer. The girls decide to stop him, and make his boat take another course, towards the sinister underwater stone circle.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: After being carried by a current into the underwater stone circle, Rikki is victim of a terrible spell: she cannot turn back into a human! To break the spell, she has to wait for the full moon – in three days’ time!

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: The Bay prepares for a great excitement: there's soon to be the first great robotics competition organized by the Dolphin City University. The events will take place underwater, and Lewis wants badly to win first prize: enrolment in the Science Faculty! Unfortunately, Zane is also participating, and true to form, can only do it by cheating.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: Emma’s kid brother Elliott happened to see Rikki’s mermaid tail in the water! He starts telling everyone he’s seen a sea monster. To cover up, the girls and Lewis start building a fake monster, to make people think it was all a hoax. But it’s too late – the whole town’s out looking for the famous “Dolphin City Monster”.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: The Vandals are carrying out a nasty plan: they have enlisted a terrible horde of stinging jellyfish to sow terror in the Bay. But the mermaids aren’t able to respond: Rikki grounded, wrongly accused of calling in a fire alarm at school, and Cleo has to help care for swimmers stung by the jellies.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: A lunar eclipse makes Cleo lose her power!! Lewis tries to get it back using scientific methods, but he runs into a lot of trouble! Meanwhile, Teddy the kid turtle has got into trouble with Bernie and the other animals in the Bay after playing too many practical jokes.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: The famous explorer Stanley Finch, is back in Dolphin City, with an amazing hi-tech mini-submarine. He’s decided, this time, to find Edward the Cruel’s sunken galleon. Lewis gets enrolled as Stanley’s assistant in the little submarine, and tries to stop him. But he triggers an accident.

programme.title: H2O : Just add Water, Season 2
programme.desc: Zane hears of treasure under the ocean and enlists Rikki to help find it, after all a mermaid can search the bottom of the ocean pretty fast. Rikki is reluctant until she discovers her dad is having trouble paying the bills - and they might be forced to move. Rikki gets Emma and Cleo to help, but conceals her true reasons for wanting the treasure.

programme.title: H2O : Just add Water, Season 2
programme.desc: Emma starts acting very weird after pricking her finger on a mysterious barb of coral, suddenly becoming ravenous for things like anchovy flavoured fish food! programme.title: H2O : Just add Water, Season 2
programme.desc: Don forces the family to go camping on Mako Island during a Full Moon. Cleo can’t get out of it so invites Emma and Rikki for back-up. programme.title: H2O : Just add Water, Season 2
programme.desc: Emma is annoyed to find the one guy she can’t stand suddenly appearing around the juice bar - Ash. As Emma and Ash clash over how the juice bar is run, we discover it’s over a lot more; they’re secretly attracted to each other.

programme.title: H2O : Just add Water, Season 2
programme.desc: Nate is still trying his best to get Cleo to like him but to no avail. Lewis and Zane find an old myth about mermaids is true - the scent of ambergris sends them wild. Zane’s plan to use it backfires when sleazy Nate gets hold of the scent and quickly has all three mermaid girls on his arm!

programme.title: H2O : Just add Water, Season 2
programme.desc: Lewis has a bad dream about Cleo being discovered as a mermaid. Elliot asks Lewis for advice on girls and Lewis obliges, just to keep him happy. programme.title: Lightening Point

programme.desc: The gang decide not to let BRANDON know about the toy lighthouse until they know more about it.

programme.title: Lightening Point

programme.title: The Elephant Princess, Season 1
programme.desc: Kuru reports to Omar and the council of elders about Vashan's hostile intrusion in the other world, but they can't counter a royal. Meanwhile Vashan has used the magical gem again, and using a box and carpet can prevent being sent back.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficción
programme.desc: Recibimos al irreverente y entrañable Mauricio Barrientos “Diablito”, actor, conductor, comediante y figura clave del entretenimiento en México. Entre risas, anécdotas y reflexiones honestas, Diablito nos muestra su lado más humano y auténtico, más allá del personaje que todos conocemos. Desde sus inicios en TV Azteca, hasta su participación en telenovelas, reality shows y programas de comedia, exploramos cómo ha evolucionado su carrera y su voz como artista. Un episodio entre la carcajada y la introspección, con un invitado que ha logrado mantenerse vigente rompiendo esquemas, sin perder su esencia.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle
programme.desc: Viajamos con Lety Zetune, experta en experiencias de lujo y agente de viajes de NUBA, nominada como una de las mejores agencias de México. Con ella, descubrimos por qué viajar no solo es una forma de conocer el mundo, sino también de reconectar contigo mismo.Desde los mejores destinos para una despedida de soltera, hasta los rincones más exóticos para una luna de miel, Lety nos guía a través de los secretos de planear un viaje inolvidable. En una charla cercana y divertida con nuestros conductores, derriba mitos sobre aerolíneas low cost, comparte tips para realizar presupuestos, revela sus destinos favoritos en México y nos cuenta cómo convirtió un viaje familiar en una búsqueda del tesoro en Machu Picchu.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficción
programme.desc: La talentosa actriz Majo Pérez nos abre las puertas de su mundo artístico y emocional. Majo relata cómo descubrió su pasión por la actuación, sus inicios en los escenarios y cómo el teatro se convirtió en su refugio. A lo largo de la entrevista, Majo reflexiona sobre los nervios que nunca desaparecen antes de salir a escena, los desafíos de interpretar personajes complejos, como su inolvidable papel de Sally Bowles en "Cabaret", y las experiencias incómodas que pueden surgir frente al público. Con sensibilidad, honestidad y carisma, Majo revela cómo ha roto moldes al interpretar roles tradicionalmente masculinos y cómo el escenario le ha permitido conocerse profundamente. Una conversación íntima y poderosa con una actriz que sigue desafiando los límites de la interpretación.

Una conversación íntima y poderosa con una actriz que sigue desafiando los límites de la interpretación.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle
programme.desc: Nos acompaña Clara Corona de Lau, consultora en cultura organizacional, fundadora de Think Lynk y pionera en transformar la forma en que vivimos nuestro espacio laboral. Reconocida por múltiples presidentes de México y galardonada con el Premio Nacional del Empresario, Clara nos comparte su visión sobre liderazgo, bienestar y propósito dentro del entorno laboral. - Descubrimos los pilares que hacen de una empresa un lugar extraordinario: confianza, valores, empatía y una cultura sólida. También exploramos la historia de su reconocida empresa “Biomédica de Referencia”, ejemplo de excelencia y humanidad. - Un episodio inspirador que revela cómo la cultura organizacional no es un lujo, sino el corazón mismo del éxito.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficción
programme.desc: El reconocido director Chava Espinosa, nos revela los secretos detrás de la dirección de series y películas que han marcado tendencia en la televisión y el streaming. Con una trayectoria que inició desde el catering hasta llegar a la dirección de producciones icónicas como "Club de Cuervos", Chava comparte su evolución profesional con honestidad y buen humor. El episodio ofrece una mirada privilegiada al proceso creativo del director: desde el manejo de actores, el arte de construir comedia, hasta la presión de las premieres y el impacto del público en el resultado final. Además, reflexiona sobre el futuro del cine independiente, los cambios de la industria tras la pandemia y sus deseos de incursionar en géneros como la acción, el terror y la ciencia ficción. Una conversación dinámica, divertida e inspiradora con uno de los nombres clave en la nueva generación de directores en Latinoamérica.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Faith Alexander arrives in Midsomer to meet her long-lost uncle Rex Masters. programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Whilst on a business trip to China, Alan King suddenly dies. The family firm, King's Crystal is in financial uncertainty, including plans to close its factory in Midsomer Magna. Six months later Alan's widow Hilary and his brother Charles are married, much to the chagrin of Alan's son Ian. With family feuds and factory workers angered by the loss of their jobs, there's many motives in the mix. When Peter Baxter, the firm's accountant is found dead, stabbed with a Masonic dagger.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The Midsomer Rocks festival is due to take place and music fans descend on neighbouring fields to enjoy the fiesta. Barnaby and Jones soon discover other band members could be targets.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When popular GP, Doctor Alan Delaney borrows fellow Dr. James Kirkwood's new car to do an evening call-out. He is mysteriously killed in a hit and run during a drive through woods in a thunderstorm. Barnaby and Jones start investigating in Midsomer Market and discover that James may have been the intended victim. The case leads them to North Walesformer home of Delyth Mostyn, James's fiance to delve further.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: In the pretty village of Luxton Deeping, there's fierce conflict between the traditional film and modern digital photographers. When their societies committee decide not to accept digital images at the annual photographic exhibition, it appears to make things worse. It leads to a confrontation at the private view. The following day Lionel Bell is found murdered in woodland, strangled with the cord of his light meter.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The inhabitants of Midsomer Magna are in the spotlight, quite literally when a production crew descend on the village and imposing Manor House. To film a version of The Scarlet Pimpernel. Not only the film crew arrive, but a notorious criminal as well, George Ince, lurking around the Manor. When Nick Cheney, the film's director is found dead, by the use of the prop guillotine. The detectives need to sift through many motives which lead to the complexity.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: In the village of Midsomer Holm, a rehabilitation scheme for reformed criminals continues. When Ronnie Tyler departs, he gets a good send off from everyone, including DCI Barnaby. Another attendee is Jack Colby, a disgraced ex-policeman and former colleague of Barnaby. Jack is decidedly frosty towards his once-former friend and refuses to chat. When Jack is later murdered, Barnaby must search for answers in Jack's past for motives.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Down at the prestigious Whiteoaks Golf Club, there is much rivalry and snobbery amongst its members. When Alistair Kingslake is coerced into the thicket to look for his ball on the notorious 13th hole, known as Crisp's Folly, he soon gets bludgeoned to death. There's many suspects, from fellow members, several villagers who only have limited time on the course and the club's staff. It is not long before another member is found stabbed in woodland close to the course.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When a newly discovered treasure by the 19th-century landscape artist Henry Hogson, makes an impression, it is later sold at auction for 400,000. Shortly after the previous owner of the artwork is tortured and killed. The following day another Hogson is stolen in a burglary and Barnaby finds himself having to investigate both. In order to get success, he needs to become an expert on Hogson with the help of art teacher Matilda Simms, they uncover many hidden secrets, deception and more.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders

Barnaby, a former spy himself, gets involved in the case.

programme.desc: Officer Parker Williams must face his feelings when his neighbor is accused of killing a private investigator.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: Two men are determined to avenge their brother's death after he is killed by Lieutenant Skinner.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: While hitchhiking his way to Sparta, a Vietnamese teenager witnesses a store robbery that turns into a murder.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: An ex-prizefighter tries to blackmail his old boss, a mafia kingpin in Detroit.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: A close friend of Chief Gillespie's is devastated over the death of his wife and angrily blames her doctor.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: A mild-mannered Sparta businessman shoots his wife and her lover and then flees with his daughter.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: A friend of Bubba's is framed for theft and kills himself. Only his young son knows the truth.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: An elderly resident of a nursing home informs Chief Gillespie that a murder has taken place at the home.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: When Jamison picks up students for cutting school, a simple truancy bust turns into a complicated murder case.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: Someone mysteriously leaves a baby on Lieutenant Bubba Skinner's doorstep.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: A conservative minister is murdered while trying to close down a traveling bordello operating near his church.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: After an employee of the high school is run off the road by the driver of a semi-truck, resulting in death.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: After her involvement in a crime committed in Philadelphia, Regina, an old friend of Althea's runs to Sparta.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: Tibbs is convinced that the right man is in custody for the murder of a cab driver, but Gillespie has doubts.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: Harriet is determined to bring her sister's killer to justice and decides to try handling things on her own.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: When an old friend apparently commits suicide, Virgil travels to Philadelphia and uncovers corruption.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: A young prostitute and mother is found murdered at a truck stop. But prime suspect has an alibi.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: Gillespie and Tibbs investigate an allegation that a popular school teacher has molested a student.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: While fishing on his day off, Bubba Skinner's dog unearths a dead baby.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: Having served his time, Prosper Hoag is on parole and back home in Sparta. Will the folks in town forgive him?

programme.desc: Gillespie's relationship with Harriet DeLong is tested when her ex-husband is caught committing a robbery.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: Gillespie and Tibbs question the suspicious circumstances around the death of an elderly shop owner.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: Virgil is working hard to reunite his family, when he discovers that his cousin may be involved in a murder.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: The owner of a local gym in Sparta tries to protect her delinquent brother, who is falsely accused of murder.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: Gillespie and Tibbs investigate a fatal car crash and medical reports show the driver may have been poisoned.

programme.desc: The roadshow reveals unseen treasures from the summer and celebrates Stoke-on-Trent.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: The roadshow reveals more unseen treasures and visits Trentham Gardens near Stoke.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: The roadshow reveals unseen treasures and visits Trentham Gardens in Staffordshire.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: The roadshow discovers treasures at the National Waterfront Museum in Swansea.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel hosts from Clitheroe, revealing more interesting valuables. Discoveries include one of the earliest vacuum cleaners, a collection of porcelain pugs, a 17th-century gate-leg table, and a superbly painted plant pot.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel takes the roadshow to Abergavenny in Wales. Treasures include a copy of a James Bond book bought for 50 pence, an art deco dollhouse, and a 17th-century spoon worth 2,000.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel's experts visit Mount Stewart in County Down, Northern Ireland, where they assess a badly damaged painting valued between 20 and 30,000, a souvenir from Laurel and Hardy, and Henry Sandon is introduced to a mug bearing his spitting image.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: The team returns to Mount Stewart in Northern Ireland, where their finds include a silver tea set presented to mark an officer's bravery at the battle of Trafalgar, a rare Wedgwood cup and saucer, and a teddy bear that has been in a box for 40 years.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the experts are in England, Woburn Abbey in Bedfordshire. Treasured items brought to light include a rare washing bowl for beards, a portrait of a handsome cat valued at 18,000 pounds, and a Victorian bracelet that imitates a snake.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: A Victorian multi-purpose penknife, a miniature theatre, and a Japanese lacquered chest of astonishing rarity and considerable value are among the treasures discovered on a visit to Clitheroe in Lancashire.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel presents from Scarborough in North Yorkshire, where the artifacts include a rare surviving roll of Beatles wallpaper, the passport once belonging to the world's smallest man, and examples of some of the finest carved whales teeth.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the roadshow team are in St Ives, Cambridgeshire. They assess an early pocket calculator, a valuable jug bought for a fiver, and a traction engine arrives in full steam.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael's experts visit Haslar in Gosport and assess a satinwood secretaire, a radiograph of Edward VIII's hand, an Edward Lear sketch, a gold-painted bronze, a Steiff teddy, and ceremonial silverware given by Tsar Nicolas II to HMS Lion.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael's experts visit Wigan in Greater Manchester. Amongst the featured items are an Art Nouveau cabinet, a cache of silver buried in World War Two, and an early depiction of women's rights.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and his team of experts visit the London to Brighton Veteran Car Run, where they invite members of the public to bring along their prized possessions for expert examination.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the team visit the RHS gardens at Wisley. Amongst the pieces under scrutiny are an early fortune teller's caravan and a credenze with a potential value of 100,000.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel takes the team of experts to the Royal Horticultural Society gardens at Wisley. The treasures coming to light are a set of letters written by Lewis Carroll and a valuable carriage clock saved from a skip.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the team head for the village of Portmeirion in North Wales. Amongst the treasures brought to light are intricate 18th Century mosaics and items made by prisoners of war as gifts.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: The team head for Haltwhistle in Northumberland. Amongst the discoveries made are original fittings from the Titanic's sister ship, the Olympic, a roman coin, and a letter from JRR Tolkein.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: The Antiques Roadshow team head for the seaside. In Hastings, the treasures uncovered are a Meissan pot, a sketch by artist Augustus John, and an unopened wedding gift from the 1920s.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: The team visits Witley Court in Worcestershire where they discover the complete cast of an early puppet theatre, a Worcester plate, a drawing by LS Lowry, and a piece of Staffordshire slipware.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the team head for the Magna Centre in Rotherham. Amongst the items brought to light are a rare clock given by Queen Victoria, a stash of silver, and some Beatles memorabilia.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel explores priceless documents, from the Domesday book to the SOS telegram sent from the Titanic and some early papers charting the work of the suffragettes.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the team head for Hampton Court Palace to uncover more family heirlooms. Among the cherished valuables are a bronze figure by Auguste Rodin and an early long case clock.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: A visit to Hampton Court reveals more fascinating finds for the experts. Among those viewed are a coral bracelet, a rare black wax doll, a dress designed by Vivienne Westwood and a small silver pig.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: The team takes the Roadshow to Hornsea on the Yorkshire coast. There they find a chastity belt dug up on a farm and an 1875 sewing machine still in use today.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Finds include an 18th Century court dress, a diamond, pearl and ruby brooch, a gift given from the Queen Mother to her Head Chef, and a tin cup that turns out to be a rare piece of silver.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel hosts a long overdue visit to Edinburgh where, amongst the treasures, the team find an ornate Russian cigarette case and a lock of Beethoven's hair.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Included in the day's finds are a hoard of 200 typewriters, a suffragette doll dressed in clothes cut from women protestors prison uniforms, a ring worn by the daughter of Charles I.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the team head for Cardiff. Amongst the treasures they discover a painting bought at a bootsale, a rare Prince of Wales tea caddy, and a dusty clock brought down from the attic.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Amongst the items featured are an African witch doctor's ceremonial stick, a school boys exercise book from 1745 and a Scandinavian drinking tankard.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Amongst the finds are a letter from Florence Nightingale, the racing silk of a famous jockey, a collection of old wedding photographs, and an Art Deco diamond brooch found in wartime London.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Amongst the finds are a machine gun from World War One, a papal portrait rescued from the bottom of a river and a set of rare maps recording the early settlement of America.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Amongst the treasures brought for valuation are an elegant grape holder made from silver, a cabinet of rare microscope slides and a ruby and diamond brooch.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: The Roadshow visits the Outer Hebrides. Amongst the items brought to light are some gruesome medical instruments and a table made from shipwreck salvage.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the Antiques Roadshow team are presented with an Art Deco cigarette case, a 'shock therapy machine', and an ornate pedestal that had been abandoned in a garage.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel marks the 200th anniversary of the Battle of Trafalgar. Among the finds are ornately decorated ostrich eggs and a box made out of debris taken from the vessel.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: The team head to Abergavenny in Wales where a strange coincidence unites two Beatles collectors. Amongst the other items brought to light are exquisitley carved whalebone and a macabre pottery model.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Amongst the items viewed are a collection of pre-historic spear heads, an early American flag, a highly valuable silver tankard and a pair of spectacles worn by Napoleon.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: The team visit Dartington Hall near Totnes in Devon to unearth more treasure. They examine a set of royal cufflinks, a letter from Admiral Nelson and a valuable collection of silver.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: A return visit to Dartington finds Michael Aspel and the team with another busy day of finds. Objects under scrutiny include a French cabinet with royal connections.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Ever wondered what happens when the Antiques Roadshow rolls out of town? In this special edition, Michael Aspel traces what has happened to some of the star items from the show.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the team are at Lichfield Cathedral in the Midlands. Amongst the items are a small statue thought to be from the tomb of Tutankhamun, an early Punch and Judy set and a sword pistol.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: The team head for Wales where Michael Aspel and team unearth more intriguing finds including a bust of Dylan Thomas, an intricate book of early silhouettes, and a plate.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: The experts return to Edinburgh. Amongst the items are an early Mickey Mouse mascot, a rare deco figurine and documents that once belonged to the bodyguard to Edward and Mrs. Simpson.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: The experts converge on Normanby Hall where treasures include a marble bust and a pair of rare candlesticks won in a newspaper competition.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Inside the Pannier Market the team discover a cache of curiosities including an inmate's uniform from the early days of Dartmoor prison and a valuable plate bought for a song at a boot sale.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel digs up unscreened finds from recent Roadshows. Amongst the objects are a ring once owned by the Romanian Royal family, an elaborate bed and a bizarre collection of coffinalia.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: The team head east to Ipswich where they discover a Duke's chamber pot now used to drink champagne and one of the earliest record players.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: The team step back in time at the Beamish Open Air Museum. Amongst the items are a rare rapier sword allegedly smuggled out of Russia in the props box of the Bolshoi Ballet.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: The team enter Border country as the Roadshow visits Manderston. Amongst the items are pieces from Queen Victoria's household, a gruesome Man Trap and Lord Palmer's collection of biscuit tins.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Amongst the objects under scrutiny in Rochdale's magnificent town hall are a gold pencil gifted by King George IV, paint brushes used by LS Lowry and the diaries of a British hangman.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: The team visits the Royal Hospital in Chelsea. Amongst the items are a Roulette table built to outwit cheats, a collection of buttons worn by Charles Dickens and a gilded bee from a royal throne.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: The team are at the seaside resort of Ventnor. Under scrutiny is a family portrait showing a Speaker of the House of Commons as a young boy and 75 Austin vehicles.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel introduces a selection of unscreened finds. Items include an Edward VIII Coronation souvenir that was hastily converted to an abdication mug and early fan mail for Elton John.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: The Roadshow team head for Lancaster. Amongst the items uncovered in the Town Hall are a valuable pair of clogs, a moving series of letters from Crimea, an anti-slavery ring and a rare tapestry.
