programme.title: Waiting for Anya
programme.desc: From the mind of world-renowned author Michael Morpurgo comes the cinematic adaptation of Waiting for Anya - a powerful and authentic true story of a young shepherd that had a key part to play in one of the world's most shocking moments in history. Based on the novel by the author of War Horse, Waiting for Anya follows the story of Jo Lalande, a thirteen-year-old shepherd living in the mountain village of Lescun. Though Europe may be ravaged by the horrors of World War II, Jo's world in the French Pyrenees has remained remarkably untouched. That is, until a ferocious encounter with a bear introduces Jo to the mysterious Benjamin, a Jewish refugee who is desperately awaiting the arrival of his missing daughter, Anya, before making his escape across the border. Making friends with Benjamin and his mother-in-law Horcada, an isolated widow who lives in the nearby mountains, Jo becomes aware of a very dangerous secret - the family are involved in smuggling Jewish children over the mountains to the safety of Spain. In a heroic act of defiance, Jo promises to assist Benjamin in his endeavours...but soon becomes embroiled in a perilous conspiracy when German troops make their descent upon the village. Filmed in the village of Lescun and the surrounding Aspe Valley, France in which the true to life story also originated, the film boasts an all-stellar cast including; Noah Schnapp (Stranger Things), Academy Award Winner Anjelica Huston (Ever After, The Addams Family), Jean Reno (Leon, The Big Blue, Ronin), Frederick Schmidt (Mission: Impossible - Fallout), Thomas Kretschmann (The Pianist, Central Intelligence) and Nicholas Rowe (Riviera, Lock Stock and Two Smoking Barrels).

programme.title: The Way
programme.desc: Martin Sheen plays Tom, an American doctor who comes to France to collect the remains of his adult son who was killed in the Pyrenees in a storm while walking The Camino de Santiago - also known as 'The Way of Saint James'. Driven by his desire to understand his lost son, Tom decides to embark on the historical pilgrimage, leaving his California life behind. Armed only with his son's backpack and guidebook, he begins the 800km historical pilgrimage but soon discovers that he won't be alone on this journey - he meets other pilgrims from around the world, all broken and looking for greater meaning in their lives. From the hardship experienced along "The Way" an unlikely group of misfits are bonded and Tom begins to learn the difference between 'The life we live and the life we choose.'

programme.title: The Butterfly Effect
programme.desc: In The Butterfly Effect Evan Treborn (Ashton Kutcher) has lost crucial moments of his life, his childhood scarred by a series of terrifying events he can't remember. When Evan realises that by reading his diaries he can unlock the past and go back in time, he tries to reclaim the missing memories by tampering with the past... with unexpected and disastrous results! The more Evan tampers with time, the more his life - and that of his friend Kayleigh (Amy Smart) - begin to unravel, and he discovers there is no such thing as a happy ending!

programme.title: Pandorum
programme.desc: Two astronauts (Dennis Quaid, Vantage Point and Ben Foster, 30 Days of Night) awaken in a hyper-sleep chamber aboard a seemingly abandoned spacecraft. It's pitch black, they are disoriented, and the only sound is a low rumble and creak from the belly of the ship. They can't remember anything like who they are and what their mission is, but one thing they do realise very quickly is that they are not alone. Slowly the spacecraft's shocking, deadly secrets are revealed and the astronauts find that they must fight to stay alive and that their survival is more important than they could ever have imagined. Directed by Christian Alvart and also starring Cam Gigandet (Twilight), Cung Le (Tekken) and newcomer Antje Traue.

programme.title: The Hitman's Apprentice
programme.desc: When 19-year-old Adam agrees to do a day's driving for his mum's gangster boyfriend Peter, it takes him on a 24-hour journey into a nightmarish world of murder, sex trafficking and revenge, in the company of aging hit man Roy.

programme.title: I Spit On Your Grave: Deja Vu
programme.desc: Finally, after 1978's I Spit On Your Grave shocked the world with its story of a beautiful career woman assaulted and left for dead, and her notorious revenge on those responsible, cinema's most lethal Lady Vengeance returns in the most anticipated sequel of all time. Reuniting star Camille Keaton and original director Meir Zarchi, I Spit On Your Grave: Deja Vu sends now successful writer Jennifer Hills hurtling back to where it all began - to face the wrath of the families of those she murdered. Kidnapped along with her daughter Christy, it's a tense game of hunt - or be hunted - against a ruthless gang of degenerates and their violently unhinged matriarch, Becky. Hailed as a feminist revenge masterpiece by some, and misunderstood as crude exploitation by others, revenge is about to come full circle in Deja Vu, the final chapter in cinema's most shocking cult franchise.

programme.title: I Know Who Killed Me
programme.desc: An idyllic small town is rocked when Aubrey Fleming (Lindsay Lohan), a bright and promising young college student is abducted and tortured by a sadistic serial killer. When she manages to escape, the traumatised girl who regains consciousness in the hospital insists that her identity is that of Dakota Moss a stripper in a seedy club and that the real Aubrey Fleming is still in mortal danger. A taut and gripping erotic thriller with a captivating riddle at its centre, I Know Who Killed Me explores the dark side of identity, sexuality and obsession.

programme.title: Calling For Love
programme.desc: Podcaster Sam Sanders is assigned to host a show that reunites lost loves. Even though Love is the last thing on her mind, Samantha falls for charming Jake who calls in with a problem. Will Samantha follow her heart this time?

programme.title: October Baby
programme.desc: As the curtain rises, Hannah hesitantly steps onto the stage for her theatrical debut in college. Yet before she can utter her first lines, Hannah-unscripted-collapses in front of the stunned audience. After countless medical tests, all signs point to one underlying factor: Hannah's difficult birth. This revelation is nothing compared to what she then learns from her parents: she was actually adopted ... after a failed abortion attempt. Bewildered, angered, and confused, Hannah turns for support to Jason, her long-time friend. Encouraged by his adventurous spirit, Hannah joins his group of friends on a Spring Break road trip, embarking on a journey to discover her hidden past ... and find hope for her unknown future. In the midst of her incredible journey, Hannah learns that every life is beautiful

programme.title: Heaven Is Waiting
programme.desc: It has been years since Ned Stevens, a charming self-made success, lost his wife Kate to cancer. Yet he still can't let go of her memory and move forward with his life.. But when Liz brings home a new boyfriend from college -- Ned finds that his comfortable world is turned upside down as Liz tries to divert his attention to Carol, an attractive single woman who lives in Ned's neighborhood.

programme.title: A Royal Surprise
programme.desc: When Riley's boyfriend, Mandla, invites her to South Africa to meet his family, she is shocked to discover that he is a prince. The news puts Riley's trust in Mandla in jeopardy, and he must do what he can to win her love back.

programme.title: Love Across Time
programme.desc: While inspecting an old British manor for its real estate potential, Chelsea discovers a portal through time that connects with the late 1700s owner of the property. When an accident occurs, the gentleman comes through and gets stuck in the present day.

programme.title: Love, Alaska
programme.desc: When two childhood friends are reunited through a generous inheritance that bestows far more on their broken hearts than they bargained for - a second chance at love.

programme.title: Mr. Right
programme.desc: Charlotte’s taking her chance in the big city. She just began working for the hottest romance site writing their hit weekly dating article, and her new best friend, Lila, is as fun as she is loyal. She also befriends a coffee barista, Liam, who shows her all the best spots in the city. But dating a new guy each week to write about is making her feel burned out. And when Liam develops feelings for her, Charlotte will need to decide whether her work is more important than her chance at love.

programme.desc: When an eight year old girl loses her mother to cancer, her mother's last wish is for her to fall in love and find that special magical person. Twenty years later, she is alone, fired, and broke. When she and a friend decide to relocate to LA to start anew, she becomes attracted to their bus driver.

programme.title: Lights, Camera, Romance
programme.desc: Actress Emma Hutton is determined to help find her friend Hope a perfect match but in doing so, she accidentally tramples on several hearts. When Emma realizes she herself has always loved her good friend Gray, Emma learns love works best when she doesn’t meddle with it. A charming romance inspired by Jane Austen’s "Emma."

programme.title: The Shunning
programme.desc: All her life Katie Lapp has longed for the forbidden things, but will her dreams come at a price too dear to pay? Why would Katie’s mother, a plain and simple Amish-woman who embraces the old ways, hide a beautiful satin baby dress in the attic? The staggering answers come on the eve of Katie’s wedding to widower, Bishop John Beiler, with the arrival of a beautiful “Englisher” woman who has been searching for her, throwing Katie’s life – present and future – into confusion.

programme.title: The Confession
programme.desc: All her life, Katie Lapp (Katie LeClerc) has known no other world than that of the Amish family who raised her. But upon discovering that she was actually adopted from out of the "English" world, her quest for answers to her identity resulted in her being shunned by her people. Now in "The Confession," the thrilling sequel to "The Shunning," Katie is on an even greater quest--to be reunited before it is too late with her long-lost birth mother, Laura Mayfield (Sherry Stringfield), who is dying of cancer. Only the challenges of being Amish in an English world stand in her way... along with one man who has other plans for her biological mother's legacy.

programme.title: Love, Lost & Found
programme.desc: Claire gets a surprise proposal on a mountain hike with her boyfriend Joey but when they get separated, a rancher turns Claire’s head and a park ranger makes Joey see they’re made for each other.

programme.title: It's a Fixer Upper
programme.desc: When The Dovers find they’re in financial jeopardy, the only answer is to sell the house Anne’s parent’s left her. But when no one wants to buy it, they decide the only way to get rid of the house is to fix it up.

programme.title: Changing Hearts
programme.desc: James Reed is quite content with the successful life he's built for himself, complete with beautiful girlfriend and great reputation in his big city career. After receiving an urgent call about his father's health, James reluctantly returns home to help with the family B&B business. James must learn about sacrificing for the ones he loves, even at the expense of his own dreams.

programme.title: Hometown Remedy
programme.desc: A busy surgeon heads back home to celebrate her father becoming mayor. But after a chance encounter with the town's only doctor-and most eligible bachelor-she witnesses true compassion which might be the prescription this doctor needs.

programme.title: An Uncommon Grace
programme.desc: Following her tour of duty, army nurse Grace Conner (Macallan) returns to her grandmother’s (McGillis) farm in Amish country. After arriving she answers Levi Troyer’s (Faris) call for medical assistance following a mysterious shooting at the nearby Troyer family farm.

programme.title: Farm To Fork To Love
programme.desc: A young and talented chef, ALICE (Meggan Kaiser), works as a sous chef at one of the top restaurants in New York. After a disastrous night serving a food critic, she receives an invitation to judge a food competition in honor of the prestigious annual fundraiser for the St. Andrew’s Children’s Hospital. programme.title: Hidden Crimes
programme.desc: (2010) Thriller with Tricia Helfer. After her jailed brother sends a cryptic message, a woman uncovers a trail to stolen millions - but deadly crooks are close behind, and they'll kill for the cash.

programme.title: The Wrong Mother
programme.desc: (2017) Thriller with Vanessa Marcil. Kaylene Larsen gives birth to beautiful twins from an in vitro procedure. But joy turns to fear when the unhinged egg donor comes to claim "her" babies.

programme.title: A Bride's Nightmare
programme.desc: (2021) Thriller with Brittany Underwood. On her wedding day, Leah is kidnapped by her fiancé's ex-girlfriend. But is it obsession, or a desperate attempt to protect her from a hidden danger?

programme.title: Forgotten Abduction
programme.desc: (2020) Thriller with Bree Williamson. Karina suspects something isn't right about Lena and her daughter, Mallie. But Mallie is all Lena has, and she isn't about to give up her secrets, or her child..

programme.title: Dangerous Bestie
programme.desc: (2018) Tense thriller starring Rosslyn Luke. Happy to be reunited at first, a woman quickly realises her former best friend has sinister plans to hold her and her family hostage.

programme.title: An Aurora Teagarden Mystery: A Very Foul Play
programme.desc: (2019) Thriller with Candace Cameron Bure. Fiction becomes reality for super sleuth Aurora when she appears in a murder mystery play, only for the stage to become an actual crime scene...

programme.title: An Aurora Teagarden Mystery: Last Scene Alive
programme.desc: (2018) Crime mystery with Candace Cameron Bure and Lexa Doig. Crime buff Aurora discovers she's the inspiration for a new film. But the plot thickens when the actress playing her is killed...

programme.title: Lost Letter Mysteries: From The Heart
programme.desc: (2016) Light-hearted drama starring Eric Mabius. Oliver and his team of Postables uncover a 200-year-old Valentine's letter that could change history - and force the downfall of a politician.

programme.title: Garage Sale Mysteries: Murder In D Minor
programme.desc: (2018) Whodunnit with Lori Loughlin and Sarah Strange. Garage sale guru and amateur sleuth Jennifer wins a piano at auction, soon learning that its past owner had a dark history.

programme.title: Garage Sale Mystery
programme.desc: (2013) Whodunnit with Lori Loughlin and Sarah Strange. After her neighbourhood is hit by a wave of break-ins, a nifty garage sale buyer turned amateur sleuth gets to work.

programme.title: The Gourmet Detective: A Healthy Place To Die
programme.desc: (2015) Crime movie spin-off of the popular TV series. A culinary genius becomes embroiled in a murder mystery at a luxury spa resort. Starring Dylan Neal and Brooke Burns.

programme.title: Martha's Vineyard: Riddled With Deceit
programme.desc: (2020) Thriller with Jesse Metcalfe. A missing family heirloom is the key to finding the truth as former detective Jeff Jackson teams up with Dr Zee Madieras to track down a murderer.

programme.title: Ruby Herring Mysteries: Prediction Murder
programme.desc: (2020) Mystery starring Taylor Cole. A reporter and detective reunite to crack a new case - this time delving into the secrets surrounding a murdered local psychic.

programme.title: Martha's Vineyard Mysteries: Poisoned In Paradise
programme.desc: (2021) Crime mystery with Jesse Metcalfe and Sarah Lind. When a waitress is poisoned after seeking his help, can ex-cop Jeff Jackson unravel what she had been trying to warn him about?

programme.title: Stolen in Her Sleep
programme.desc: (2021) Psychological thriller with Morgan Bradley. A new mother's world unravels when she suspects someone is trying to steal her baby - is it real or a dangerous figment of her sleep-deprived mind?

programme.title: A Stranger with My Kids
programme.desc: (2017) Thriller with Ashley Scott. When Karen hires Alex, a male nanny, she's just looking for help with her sons. But Alex is looking for a family of his own, and he'll do anything to get it...

programme.title: Her Final Bow
programme.desc: (2017) Thriller with Jordan Ladd. Years after a violent attack forced her to retire, an opera singer faces her fears at a comeback event. But as new dangers emerge, will this performance be her last?

programme.title: Secrets That Kill
programme.desc: Jenny is unhappy when her mum Laura returns from a world cruise with a new younger husband.

programme.title: False Pretenses
programme.desc: (2004) Taut thriller with Peta Wilson. After a conman steals their money and drives her husband to suicide, Dianne tries to start again. But when the swindler reappears, revenge is her only goal...

programme.title: Stolen in Her Sleep
programme.desc: (2021) Psychological thriller with Morgan Bradley. A new mother's world unravels when she suspects someone is trying to steal her baby - is it real or a dangerous figment of her sleep-deprived mind?

programme.title: An Aurora Teagarden Mystery: The Disappearing Gam
programme.desc: (2018) Crime mystery starring Candace Cameron Bure and Lexa Doig. Crime-solving librarian Aurora is back on the case when students - including her cousin - vanish from a local college.

programme.title: Aurora Teagarden Mysteries: How to Con A Con
programme.desc: (2021) Cosy crime drama with Candace Cameron Bure. Librarian-turned-sleuth Aurora takes a break from wedding planning when one of Aida's real estate clients is found murdered.

programme.title: Lost Letter Mysteries: The Impossible Dream
programme.desc: (2015) Heartwarming mystery starring Eric Mabius. The Postables work against the clock decoding a letter to rescue a soldier in Afghanistan and reunite her with her family.

programme.title: Garage Sale Mystery
